# kratos-admin

`kratos-admin` 是一个前后端分离的管理系统仓库，包含 Go + Kratos 后端、Vue 管理后台、uni-app 应用底座、React/Taro 应用底座、版本化数据库迁移和模块脚手架。

## 已实现能力

- 账号密码、验证码、OAuth、TOTP/WebAuthn 多因素认证、JWT 刷新、租户和 Casbin 权限。
- TOTP 多因素认证、一次性恢复码和 `disabled`、`optional`、`all_required` 全局策略。
- 开放授权客户端管理：客户端按租户绑定，凭据换取 Bearer Token，并由 operation 拦截器和 HTTP 加解密 Filter 校验租户、状态、IP 白名单、JSON API 白名单及协议密文。
- 用户、角色、部门、岗位、菜单、字典、配置、任务、文件资产、日志、地区、API 和迁移记录管理。
- 后台工作台提供用户/角色概览、登录趋势、登录结果和操作动作分布统计。
- 消息分类、租户内定向/全员站内信、收件箱已读/归档、Redis 投递恢复和 Admin/uni-app/Taro 消息中心。
- Proto 驱动的 HTTP、gRPC、OpenAPI、Agent Tool、MCP Tool 和 TypeScript RPC 生成。
- AI 会话、流式消息、附件、工具调用、重试、再生成和分支会话。
- 管理端代码生成配置、预览、生成进度和还原。
- 运行日志浏览：实时控制台 SSE、历史日志查询、级别和关键字筛选及历史原文件下载。
- 登录来源策略（全局及租户/用户定向规则）、密码复杂度策略、当前会话撤销、审计日志异步落库与保留清理、受控 MySQL 备份恢复任务。
- 构建期收集当前项目、宿主项目和外部模块的 README/docs，并在管理端统一查看。
- 可挂载的 Go Core 模块；后端实现 `module.Module`，通过 `Resources` 提供静态资源，并由启动入口交给 Core 统一注册协议服务。
- 管理端、uni-app、Taro 和后端错误目录的语言集合由语言包自动发现；动态菜单、字典和代码生成同步支持所有已注册语言。

仓库不包含商城、订单、支付或推荐等业务模块。

## 目录

| 目录 | 说明 | 文档 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backend` | Kratos 服务、Proto、GORM、迁移和 Core 宿主组合。 | [backend/README.md](backend/README.md) |
| `frontend/admin` | 管理端 workspace，包含默认宿主、core、System 和 CLI。 | [frontend/admin/README.md](frontend/admin/README.md) |
| `frontend/uni-app` | uni-app workspace，包含默认宿主、core、system 和 CLI。 | [frontend/uni-app/README.md](frontend/uni-app/README.md) |
| `frontend/taro-app` | React/Taro workspace，包含默认宿主、core、UI、system 和 CLI。 | [frontend/taro-app/README.md](frontend/taro-app/README.md) |
| `docs` | 当前架构、操作流程和专题说明。 | [docs/README.md](docs/README.md) |

开放授权协议的接口范围、拦截器边界和加密扩展点见 [docs/开放授权协议设计.md](docs/开放授权协议设计.md)。

## 环境

- Go `1.27.0`。
- Node.js `^20.19.0` 或 `>=22.12.0`。
- pnpm 版本以各 workspace 的 `packageManager` 为准：管理端 `10.33.4`，uni-app 与 Taro 应用端 `10.13.1`。
- MySQL 和 Redis；默认连接见 `backend/configs/data.yaml`。
- Docker 部署需要可用的 Docker CLI 与 Docker daemon。
- 启用 TOTP 绑定时，`mfa.encryption_key` 有显式值则使用该值，留空时在实际保护 TOTP 密钥时按 `kratos-kit:mfa/encryption` 从运行时密钥服务派生；启用 WebAuthn 时还要配置 `mfa.webauthn.rp_id` 与 `mfa.webauthn.rp_origins`。配置文件中的敏感值应使用 `ENC[...]` 保存。
- Buf、protoc 插件、Wire 和 gorm-gen 只在重新生成代码时需要，可通过 `make -C backend init` 安装。

直接执行 `make` 或 `make help` 查看仓库级命令；Backend 和 Frontend 的完整目标分别使用 `make -C backend help`、`make -C frontend help` 查看。

## 本地启动

先创建数据库：

```sql
CREATE DATABASE kratos_admin CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
```

安装前端依赖：

```bash
make -C frontend init
```

如果依赖目录需要完全重建：

```bash
make -C frontend reinstall
```

启动后端：

```bash
make -C backend run APP_ENV=dev
```

`run` 会先刷新启动所需的接口、OpenAPI 和 Wire 产物；确认生成产物未变化时可使用 `make -C backend run-only APP_ENV=dev` 直接启动。基础配置使用 `<name>.yaml`，环境差异使用 `<name>.<env>.yaml`，缺少当前环境文件时自动回退基础配置。完整目标、执行顺序和参数见 [Backend 常用流程](backend/README.md#常用流程)。

启动全部前端开发环境（管理后台、uni-app/Taro H5 和微信小程序）：

```bash
make -C frontend run
```

也可以按端启动（每个常驻命令都应在独立终端运行）：

```bash
make -C frontend run-admin
cd frontend/uni-app && pnpm dev:h5
cd ../taro-app && pnpm dev:h5
```

| 服务 | 默认地址 |
| --- | --- |
| 后端 HTTP | `http://localhost:7001` |
| 后端 HTTPS（`APP_ENV=https`） | `https://localhost:7001` |
| 后端 gRPC | `localhost:6001` |
| 管理后台 | `http://localhost:8848` |
| uni-app H5 | `http://localhost:5004` |
| Taro H5 | `http://localhost:5002` |

uni-app 和 Taro H5 默认分别使用 `5004` 与 `5002`，可以同时启动。局域网设备访问 uni-app 时，将 `localhost` 替换为开发机局域网 IP。

局域网 HTTPS 联调时，在仓库根目录生成共享证书，并让后端使用 HTTPS 环境：

```bash
bash scripts/generate-dev-cert.sh 192.168.1.100
make -C backend run-only APP_ENV=https
```

管理端开发代理需要在本地环境文件中将 `VITE_PROXY` 的后端地址改为 `https://localhost:7001`；Taro 和 uni-app H5 需要在各自 `.env.development-h5.local` 中将 `VITE_APP_API_URL` 改为 `https://localhost:7001`。三端开发代理都会跳过自签名证书校验。

默认迁移提供开发账号 `super / 112233` 和 `admin / 112233`。部署前必须修改默认密码、JWT 密钥、数据库和 Redis 凭据。

## 生成与检查

```bash
make gen
make check
make build
make -C backend fmt
```

`make gen` 按 Backend、Frontend、文档和 OpenAPI 的顺序生成全仓产物；`make check` 按 Backend、三个前端 workspace 和国际化的顺序执行检查。根目录 `make build` 构建后端二进制及三个前端 H5 宿主；只构建全部前端（H5 + 微信小程序）可使用 `make -C frontend build`，仅构建 H5 使用 `make -C frontend build-h5`，生成全部 npm 发布包使用 `make -C frontend package`。

`make -C backend cli` 会安装 `kratos-kit/cmd/normalize-go-imports`，`make -C backend fmt` 再运行该命令并使用 `goimports` 格式化 Backend 全部 Go 文件。

该工具实现统一位于 `kratos-kit/cmd/normalize-go-imports`，不再在 Admin 仓库保留独立 Make 目标。

后端默认通过 `make -C backend build` 构建 `linux/amd64` 二进制；仓库根目录的 `make package` 会生成包含 `bin/server` 和 `configs` 的后端发布压缩包，并同时生成全部前端 npm 包。目标平台可使用 `GOOS`、`GOARCH` 覆盖。

Docker 镜像通过仓库根目录命令构建：

```bash
make docker-build IMAGE=kratos-admin TAG=latest
make docker-run IMAGE=kratos-admin TAG=latest APP_ENV=dev
make docker-stop IMAGE=kratos-admin TAG=latest
```

构建命令先检查 Docker，再构建管理后台、uni-app H5、Taro H5 和 Linux 后端程序。运行命令发布宿主机 `7001/6001` 端口，将 `backend/data`、`backend/logs`、`backend/backups` 分别映射到容器的 `/app/data`、`/app/logs`、`/app/backups`，并首次初始化可在宿主机修改的 `backend/runtime/configs` 后映射到 `/app/configs`。三端静态站点随镜像发布，启动时合并到 `/app/data`，已有上传文件不会被清空；Core 根据 `oss.root_directory` 将本地对象统一映射到 `/data/`。完整构建参数和运行示例见本节。

本地只启动依赖服务可使用：

```bash
docker compose -f docker-compose.libs.yml up -d
docker compose -f docker-compose.libs.yml --profile object-storage up -d
```

该 Compose 只负责 MySQL、Redis 和可选 MinIO，不改变现有单镜像应用部署方式。

`I18N_LOCALES` 使用逗号分隔的 BCP 47 语言代码列表（默认 `en-US,zh-TW,ja-JP`），统一控制项目文档和 OpenAPI 的目标语言。`make i18n-docs` 由仓库内 `scripts/project_docs.py` 按三段路径范围收集 README 与 docs Markdown，再将正文按 `I18N_BATCH_CHARS`（默认 400）分片翻译并按原顺序合并，生成 `docs.json` 和 `docs.<locale>.json`；对应的 `README.en-US.md`、`guide.ja-JP.md` 等语言源文件存在时直接使用，否则才执行机器翻译。Google V1 会按多个 client 顺序切换，全部不可用时再使用 MyMemory，并保留 Markdown 代码、链接和占位符。语言目录只本地化文档正文和显示文件名，`README.md` 显示名、目录名称及稳定路径保持不变。如需使用外部实现，可通过 `PROJECT_DOCS_SCRIPT` 覆盖脚本路径。`make i18n-openapi` 生成 OpenAPI 多语言 YAML。离线生成使用 `I18N_OFFLINE=1 make i18n`。

`backend/api/gen`、`backend/internal/data/gen`、`backend/internal/docs/assets/docs*.json`、`backend/internal/docs/docs.go`、各前端包的 `src/rpc`、OpenAPI 及 `wire_gen.go` 都是生成产物，不得手工修改。所有前端 RPC 的 Buf 配置统一位于 `backend/api`，管理端通过 `make -C frontend ts-admin` 生成，应用端分别通过 `make -C frontend ts-uni-app` 和 `make -C frontend ts-taro-app` 生成；需要一次生成三端时执行 `make -C frontend ts`，全仓生成使用根目录 `make gen`。

`make -C backend gen` 会同时生成 `backend/internal/module` 的公共入口内部 Wire 产物和 `backend/internal/cmd/server` 的独立启动 Wire 产物；单独刷新前者使用 `make -C backend public-wire`，单独刷新自定义组合根可通过 `WIRE_DIR` 指定包含 `wire.go` 的目录。

外部 Go 项目将 `github.com/liujitcn/kratos-admin/backend` 的具名模块、资源、定时任务、SSE 流和队列消费者贡献与自身贡献合并后，再交给 `github.com/liujitcn/kratos-core` 创建协议服务及应用生命周期；外部生成代码不会引用 `backend/internal`。

`make i18n-openapi` 会在生成 `openapi.yaml` 后同步生成 `openapi.en-US.yaml`、`openapi.zh-TW.yaml` 和 `openapi.ja-JP.yaml`。默认资源来自后端错误目录和管理端 Core 语言包；外部资源可通过 `OPENAPI_I18N_CONTENT="locale=path"` 传入。未命中的文案默认自动翻译：英文和日语使用 Google V1，繁体中文使用 OpenCC；设置 `I18N_AUTO_LOCALIZE=0` 可关闭自动翻译。无网络环境使用 `I18N_OFFLINE=1 make i18n-openapi`。

## 国际化

语言包定义系统能够渲染的语言集合，`base_language` 表只负责运行时启用状态、名称、排序和主语言配置。管理端语言偏好保存为 `kratos-admin:locale`，uni-app 和 Taro 保存为 `kratos-app:locale`；所有 HTTP、刷新令牌、fetch、SSE、uni.request 和 Taro.request 请求都会发送规范化的 `Accept-Language`。固定文案由各 workspace 的 core/System JSON 语言包维护，动态菜单和字典由后端翻译表按请求语言解析，缺少当前语言译文时回退主语言。

新增语言不需要修改 Go、TypeScript 或模块注册代码：在 `backend/internal/i18n/assets` 和三个 workspace 的六个前端语言包目录中增加同名 JSON，然后执行 `make i18n-sync`。脚本会校验语言集合、语言键和占位符，并生成六个前端注册文件、Element Plus 和 Day.js 映射。语言名称、排序、启用状态和主语言由 `base_language` 数据库记录提供；`common.language.*` 用于编译期离线显示和生成语言迁移的初始名称。新增语言的完整文件清单和迁移流程见 [国际化语言扩展指南](docs/国际化语言扩展指南.md)。需要把语言加入新部署数据库时，直接更新唯一的 `v0.0.1` 初始化迁移；已有数据库的启用状态不会被迁移覆盖。

动态资源的主语言由 `base_language.is_primary` 配置。创建或更新菜单、字典、字典项和系统配置时，后端按请求 `Accept-Language` 将输入文本转换为主语言写入主表；请求语言不是主语言时，原文写入对应翻译表，其他已启用非主语言也只保存在翻译表。系统配置名称、菜单标题、字典名称和字典项标签支持在管理端点击名称打开翻译弹窗，文本/富文本配置值支持运行时翻译回退。

国际化常用命令：

```bash
make i18n-check
make i18n-verify
make i18n-sync
make i18n-docs
make i18n-openapi
make i18n
```

新增语言属于初始化数据，统一写入唯一的 `v0.0.1` 迁移：

```bash
I18N_LOCALE=ja-JP make i18n-locale
I18N_LOCALE=de-DE I18N_OFFLINE=1 make i18n-locale
```

在线模式优先使用 Google V1 的多个 client，全部不可用时使用 MyMemory；繁体中文优先使用 OpenCC，离线模式使用内置术语表和 OpenCC。生成后应审核 JSON 与 SQL；已有数据库的语言启用状态不会被覆盖。运行时翻译表单仍可对动态资源执行即时翻译，已有非空译文不会覆盖。

## 发布

统一发布会更新并发布 10 个 npm 包：

- `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-system`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-cli`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-uni-app-core`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-uni-app-system`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-uni-app-cli`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-core`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-ui`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-system`
- `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app-cli`

```bash
make tag VERSION=0.0.30
```

`make tag` 会先执行只读的 `make i18n-verify`，检查语言包、SQL 翻译脚本、OpenAPI 多语言文档和项目文档生成物；生成物未同步时会直接拒绝发布，不会在发布过程中自动翻译或改写文件。随后发布脚本要求当前分支为远程默认分支且与 `origin` 同步，执行后端测试和前端打包，然后推送 `vX.Y.Z`、`backend/vX.Y.Z`、`npm/vX.Y.Z`。`npm/vX.Y.Z` 触发 `.github/workflows/publish-npm.yml`，通过 npm Trusted Publishing 发布以上 10 个包；三个默认宿主均为私有包，不参与发布。本机需要可用的 `git`、`gh` 和 GitHub 登录态。

只做本地 npm 发布时：

```bash
pnpm login
make -C frontend publish
```

发布脚本会跳过 registry 中已存在的同版本包，支持失败后重试。私有 registry 可通过 `NPM_REGISTRY`、`NPM_ACCESS` 和 `NPM_TAG` 覆盖。

documents.content:
# backend

Backend also provides message classification, site message management, user inbox, Redis delivery recovery, background workbench statistics, file asset metadata, login source policy, session revocation, audit event asynchronous logging, log retention cleaning and controlled database backup tasks. Security, messaging, and open authorization default data are unified and provided by the `v0.0.1` initialization migration.

`backend` retains the API contract, Go generated interface, Service implementation, Biz business layer, as well as task scheduling, HTTP/gRPC/MCP/AI registration and necessary data access closures; the process entry is at `internal/cmd/server`. The root package provides a common boundary that can be reused by external Core hosts through `ProviderSet`, `NewModuleResources`, `NewModules`, `NewTasks`, `NewStreams` and `NewQueueConsumers`. `internal/adapter/core` is responsible for adapting the database access capabilities generated by Admin to `kratos-core/data`. Store/Writer contract, `internal/module` only hosts module implementations. AI Runtime is implemented in `internal/biz`, and the external reuse entry is`pkg/agent`; The business module publishes site messages through `pkg/notification.Publish`, and the internal affairs and Dispatch recovery links are responsible for final delivery. The open authorization client uses a single table JSON operation whitelist and binds the tenant, and the public endpoint issues the client Bearer Token; the HTTP middleware verifies the tenant, status, IP whitelist and API range respectively, and the HTTP encryption and decryption Filter decrypts the client data before requesting binding and encrypts it after a successful response. Login authentication supports TOTP multi-factor authentication, one-time recovery codes, and global and tenant/user-directed login source policies.

## Directory

```text
backend
├── internal/cmd/server             # Admin 独立启动入口与 Wire 组合根
├── api
│   ├── proto                         # Proto 契约
│   └── gen/go                        # Buf 生成的 Go 接口、HTTP、gRPC 和工具代码
├── internal/biz                      # 业务 Case、DTO、代码生成和辅助领域代码
├── internal/adapter/core             # Core Store/Writer 契约的 Admin 持久化适配
├── bootstrap.go                      # 对外 ProviderSet 和模块/任务/SSE/队列/资源入口
├── internal/module                   # Admin 到 kratos-core 的内部模块适配和资源实现
│   ├── module.go                     # Core Module 协议注册
│   ├── resources.go                  # module.Module 静态资源
│   ├── init.go                        # Admin 模块 ProviderSet
│   └── wire.go / wire_gen.go          # 公共入口使用的内部依赖装配
├── pkg/agent                         # 对外复用的 AI Runtime、模型和工具 API
├── pkg/runtimeconfig                  # 对外复用的运行配置 Proto 注册、校验和缓存 API
├── pkg/notification                  # 对外复用的站内信发布 API
├── internal/task                     # 异步任务与定时任务执行器
├── internal/server                   # 服务拦截器和 API 模块注册适配
│   └── middleware/{oauth,logstream}  # 按业务分组的 HTTP/gRPC 服务拦截器
├── internal/data/gen                 # GORM 生成的模型、查询和仓储
├── internal/service                  # Proto Service 实现
├── internal/const                    # 业务常量
├── internal/i18n/assets              # 业务语言资源
├── data                              # 前端 H5 产物和 OSS 上传对象
├── logs                              # 运行日志和日志入库回退文件
├── backups                           # 本地备份工作目录
├── codegen/restore                   # 代码生成还原快照
└── migration                         # 代码生成业务使用的迁移资源
```

## Common processes

After entering the `backend` directory, first use the help to view all targets, parameter default values ​​and override examples:

```bash
make help
```

First development installation of Buf, protoc, Wire, gorm-gen, goimports and inspection tools:

```bash
make init
```

Daily startup use:

```bash
make run
```

`make run` will refresh the necessary products in the order of "protobuf Go -> OpenAPI -> Independent Entry Wire -> Start Service". When it is confirmed that there is no change in the generated product, you can skip the generation and start directly:

```bash
make run-only
```

The default configuration directory is `./configs`, and the default operating environment is `dev`. The basic configuration uses `<name>.yaml`, and the environment difference uses `<name>.<env>.yaml`; when the environment file exists, it is loaded after the basic configuration, and when it does not exist, it falls back to the basic configuration. You can overwrite the configuration directory, operating environment or append startup parameters:

Session life cycle and upload security scan use `authn.session`, `oss.upload_security` startup configuration; audit logs are maintained in "System Management → Backup Management → Data Archive" and are maintained by table, and database backup is maintained in "System Management → Backup Management → Data Backup" by data source. The log warehousing fallback configuration uses the hidden configuration `baseLogFallback` alone; the backup integrity key and encryption key are derived from the runtime key service by `kratos-admin:backup/integrity` and `kratos-admin:backup/encryption` respectively during specific task execution. Normal system configuration is still maintained by the "System Configuration" page. HTTP ordinary requests only use `server.http.timeout` and `server.http.max_body_bytes`, `/events`, `/mcp` and AI message flow automatically skip the ordinary request timeout.

The disk root directory for local file storage is configured only by `oss.root_directory` for `configs/oss.yaml`, and Core maps that directory to `/data/`. The uploaded objects are layered by `业务类型/文件分类/年/月/日/文件名`, and the database saves the OSS object path; `backend/data` only retains the three-terminal H5 product and uploaded object, and the log, backup, and code generation restoration snapshots are located at `backend/logs`, `backend/backups`, and `backend/codegen/restore` respectively.

The multi-factor authentication method is selected by the system configuration `securityMfaMethod`. Currently, `totp` and `webauthn` are supported. The runtime MFA parameters are loaded through the `mfa.yaml` or `mfa` node of the environment overlay file `mfa.dev.yaml`; when `mfa.encryption_key` has an explicit value, it is used first, and when left blank, `kratos-kit:mfa/encryption` is derived from the runtime key service when the TOTP key is actually encrypted or decrypted. Disabling TOTP on the management and application sides requires the current password and dynamic password or recovery code, and disabling WebAuthn requires the current password and a Passkey or recovery code verification. In the production environment, do not write real keys to the warehouse or database. The complete field is subject to `kratos-kit/api/proto/config/v1/mfa.proto`.

```bash
make run-only CONF=/path/to/configs
make run-only APP_ENV=prod
make run-only RUN_ARGS='--help'
```

For example, `APP_ENV=dev` will load `data.yaml` and then `data.dev.yaml`, while ignoring `data.prod.yaml`. Local development configurations are uniformly saved in `*.dev.yaml`, and such files are not included in Git by default.

When you need to start the HTTP service locally through HTTPS, first generate a development certificate shared by the front-end and back-end in the warehouse root directory, and then use the `https` operating environment:

```bash
bash scripts/generate-dev-cert.sh 192.168.1.100
make -C backend run-only APP_ENV=https
```

`APP_ENV=https` will load `configs/server.https.yaml`, reuse the warehouse roots `certs/dev-cert.pem` and `certs/dev-key.pem`, and provide the HTTP service address `:7001` in HTTPS mode, that is, access `https://localhost:7001` or `https://192.168.1.100:7001`. This environment coverage configuration cannot be directly reused with the container release path. The production environment should mount the certificate to the deployment directory and fill in the actual path in the corresponding configuration.

Independent entrance injects `kratoscore.ProviderSet` and internal module ProviderSet; Core is responsible for unified creation and management of HTTP, gRPC, MCP, SSE, queue and scheduled task runtime. Admin registers six complete audit log models and is responsible for automatic migration; Core writes API/policy logs asynchronously, and Admin asynchronously writes login, operation, data access, and permission logs.

Before each execution of a scheduled task, the Redis distributed lock is obtained according to the task number. The scheduled trigger will be skipped when the lock is held by other instances. If executed manually, a lock competition error will be returned. When the Redis lock initialization fails, a warning will be logged and downgraded to an in-process memory lock; this mode is only suitable for single-instance operation. Multi-instance deployment must ensure that each instance is connected to the same Redis and is in Redis lock mode.

## Execute after modification

| Modify Scenario | Command | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Proto contract | `make api openapi` | Generate Backend protobuf Go and OpenAPI source documents; front-end TypeScript RPC uses `make -C ../frontend ts` in the repository root directory, and can also execute `ts-admin`, `ts-uni-app` or `ts-taro-app` on a per-end basis. |
| Database table structure | `make gorm-gen` | Update the development library first, and then generate `GORM_GEN_CONFIG`, `GORM_GEN_DATABASE` and `GORM_TABLE`. |
| ProviderSet or construction parameters | `make public-wire wire` | Refresh the public entrance internal assembly and independent service entrance respectively. |
| README or docs | `make -C .. project-docs` | Collect Markdown from the warehouse root directory and generate document directories for each language. |
| Language pack or internationalization resource | `make -C .. i18n` | Internationalization belongs to the public command of the warehouse root directory. |
| Go import alias | `make cli fmt` | `cli` installs `kratos-kit/cmd/normalize-go-imports`, `fmt` runs it and formats it with `goimports`. |
| Multiple types of backend generation sources change simultaneously | `make gen` | Execute GORM, interface, OpenAPI, Wire and formatting in sequence; access to the development database is required. |

All generated products must be refreshed through the above command and cannot be modified manually.

Go import alias normalization command is provided by `kratos-kit/cmd/normalize-go-imports`, Admin does not keep a local copy; install the command first, then perform formatting:

```bash
make cli
make fmt
```


## Check

Perform full Backend check before committing:

```bash
make check
```

`make check` runs `make lint` and `make test` in sequence without automatically formatting the code. For full warehouse inspection (including internationalization), please execute `make check` in the warehouse root directory. When formatting is required, execute first:

```bash
make fmt
```

You can also run an item individually:

```bash
make lint
make test
```

## Build

The executable files of `linux/amd64` and `CGO_ENABLED=0` are built by default:

```bash
make build
```

The product is `bin/server`. Other platforms can override parameters:

```bash
make build GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 BINARY=bin/server-darwin-arm64
```

Publishing compressed packages, Docker images, and three-end static resources is a warehouse-level process. Please execute `make package` or `make docker-build` in the root directory; see the root directory README for corresponding parameters and running examples.

## Common parameters

| Parameters | Default Value | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONF` | `./configs` | Service running configuration directory. |
| `APP_ENV` | `dev` | Select the `<name>.<env>.yaml` environment override configuration. |
| `RUN_ARGS` | Empty | Parameters appended to the service command. |
| `CGO_ENABLED` | `0` | Whether to enable CGO when building Go. |
| `GOOS` / `GOARCH` | `linux` / `amd64` | Build target platform. |
| `BINARY` | `bin/server` | Executable file output path. |
| `ARCHIVE` | `dist/backend-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz` | Backend binary compressed package output path (called by the root directory `make package`). |
| `PUBLIC_WIRE_DIR` | `internal/module` | The directory containing the internal `wire.go` used by the public entrance. |
| `WIRE_DIR` | `internal/cmd/server` | The directory where the independent entrance `wire.go` is located. |
| `GORM_GEN_CONFIG` | `configs/data.dev.yaml` | The data source configuration used by GORM generation. |
| `GORM_GEN_DATABASE` | Empty | Optional database name, the configuration file is read by default. |
| `GORM_TABLE` | List of built-in tables | Comma-separated list of GORM generated tables. |

## External host reuse

When an external Go project reuses Backend, add the merged ProviderSet of `kratoscore.ProviderSet`, `backend.ProviderSet` and the host to its own Wire combination root:

```go
func NewApp(ctx *bootstrap.Context) (*kratos.App, func(), error) {
	panic(wire.Build(
		kratoscore.ProviderSet,
		backend.ProviderSet,
		mergeProviderSet,
	))
}
```

The root package exports named contributions through `AdminResources`, `AdminModules`, `AdminTasks`, `AdminStreams`, and `AdminConsumers`, and the merge of the host's ProviderSet explicitly appends them with contributions from other business modules into the Core final set. The public constructor only uses Core public types, and the externally generated `wire_gen.go` will not depend on `backend/internal`.

`backend.NewModules` initializes the host process-level running log collector; after the external project is connected to Backend in the above manner, the logs written by itself and other registered modules to stdout/stderr will also enter the running log real-time console, and the historical log files will be read according to the host's log configuration.

When the JWT key in `configs/auth.yaml` has an explicit value, it is used first; when left blank, the server and client jointly press `kratos-kit:authn/jwt` to derive it from the runtime key service. Sensitive values ​​in configuration files should be saved using `ENC[...]` and do not submit clear text keys.

The management browser uses Cookie-only refresh token mode: the refresh token is only saved in the Path narrowed HttpOnly Cookie, and the access token is only saved in the page memory; uni-app and Taro do not send this mode identifier and continue to use their existing token transmission methods.

When external modules are connected to AI, use `pkg/agent.NewRuntime` to create the runtime, and register Eino `InvokableTool` through `RuntimeConfig.AdminTools/AppTools` or `Runtime.RegisterTool`; simple structured tools give priority to using `pkg/agent.InferTool` to automatically generate parameter schema. Fixed processes such as comment moderation and content extraction can combine `NewChatClient`, `NewStructuredRunner`, `SchemaFor` and multimodal Part constructors without referencing the `internal` package. Implement `ToolAccessChecker` when permission control is required. If not connected to the permission system, keep `Checker` as `nil`.

When the external module accesses the running configuration, it defines the configuration message in its own Proto and registers the key, default value and sensitive field through `pkg/runtimeconfig.Register`; when Admin starts, it will uniformly initialize the `base_config` hidden configuration and refresh Redis. Configure JSON to use ProtoJSON encoding and decoding and Protovalidate verification. The verification rule ID can be directly used as an internationalized message key. The universal launch configuration preferentially reuses `config.v1.Bootstrap` over `kratos-kit/api`, such as `authn.session`, `oss.upload_security`, `logger`, and `data`.

documents.content:
# AI Assistant

AI assistant is a shared session capability among the management end, uni-app, and Taro application end. The three entry points use the same set of `base.v1`interfaces and data tables, but the available tools and quick entry points are filtered by terminal.

## Implemented capability

- Session creation, listing, renaming, deletion, and persistence branches.
- Message list, text and attachment sending, edit the last message, Delete, retry failure and regenerate.
Direct streaming responses to three types of SSE events:
-`delta`, `finish`, and `error`.
- Markdown, model source, Token, time consumption of the first Token, total time consumption and tool call records.
- Agent Tool generated by filtering terminals, interface switches and user permissions.
- Fixed process quick entry and Structured actions; Old message actions will be judged as expired by the server.
- Responses Server-side tool logging; A clear unavailable error is returned when the current model is not enabled.

## Contract and data

: Capability: Proto: HTTP prefix
| --- | --- | --- |
: Quick access: `backend/api/proto/base/v1/ai_tool.proto`: `/api/v1/base/ai/shortcut`
: Session: `ai_session.proto`: `/api/v1/base/ai/session`
: Message: `ai_message.proto`: `/api/v1/base/ai/session/{session_id}/message`

is persisted to `ai_session`and `ai_message`. One round of message saves input, output, attachments, tools, tokens, time consumption, status and optional structured process content. The action must carry the current latest success message of `source_message_id`, `action_id`and `flow_version`.

directly returns `text/event-stream`without using the general `/events/{stream}`subscription. At the end of the stream, the `finish`event returns the final message and the updated session.

## Backend link.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  API["AiMessageService"] --> Case["AiMessageCase"]
  Case --> Runtime["biz/base/ai.Runtime"]
  Runtime --> ADK["internal/biz/agent/adk"]
  ADK --> Model["Eino Agentic Model"]
  ADK --> Tools["按终端和权限筛选的工具"]
  Case --> DB[("ai_session / ai_message")]
```

`internal/biz/base/ai`is responsible for business protocols, historical messages, attachments, terminal policies, fixed processes, and result persistence. `internal/biz/agent`isolates the model, message, ADK, Middleware, Callback, Tool, Structured and Workflow details of Eino.

Agent Tool comes from the generated code, and `agent_status`controls whether it can be used by AI. `mcp_status`independently controls whether it is exposed as an MCP Tool. The two are not the same switch.

## Management end

management terminal is located at `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/views/ai/chat`:

File Responsibilities
| --- | --- |
: `index.vue`: Session, message, send and action master orchestration. |
: `components/SessionPanel.vue`: Session search, creation, switching, renaming and deletion. |
: `components/ChatPanel.vue`: Message area, empty state, quick entry and message operations. |
: `components/XSender.vue`: Text, attachments and sending status. |
: `components/AiMarkdown.vue`: Markdown and code content. |
, `stream.ts`, `message.ts`, SSE parsing and message state normalization. |

System module also registers the AI icon as the top tool. Structured process block components are not built-in fixed implementations; Other business modules can provide the `flowBlocks`extension through `ADMIN_AI_EXTENSION`.

## Application side

uni-app is located at `frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai`, and Taro is located at `frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/views/pagesMember/ai`. Both ends offer session drawers, welcome quick entry, input and attachments, message flow, and multi-terminal SSE parsing. The page belongs to the `pagesMember`package and uses the same `base.v1`RPC and API encapsulation. H5 uses Fetch SSE; Wechat Mini Programs utilize the block request capabilities of their respective platforms.

## Configuration and verification

model is located at `backend/configs/ai.yaml`, and the difference in the development environment is at `backend/configs/ai.dev.yaml`. The service can still start when the complete model configuration is not provided, but the AI runtime is turned off.

. Modify the execution of `pnpm lint:oxlint`and `pnpm type:check`on the management end; Modify uni-app or Taro to execute the `pnpm lint`and `pnpm tsc`corresponding to the workspace. When module protocols or runners are involved, execute `pnpm test`and `pnpm check:exports`. The front end should at least check the status of empty sessions, historical sessions, sending in progress, failed, attachments, and expired process actions.

# Front-end Component list

This article only records the components that exist in the current code and can be directly used, as well as their boundaries. The management end component implementation is located at `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/components`; The base components, UI packages and private page components of uni-app and Taro belong to their respective workspaces.

## Management End Public component

: Scene: Component: Description
| --- | --- | --- |
: Paginated list, search, column Settings, batch operations; `ProTable`: Configure the list using `columns`, `headerActions`and `requestApi`. |
: Add or edit pop-up window `FormDialog`: Combine `ProDialog`and `ProForm`. The page is responsible for verification, submission and refreshing. |
: Details, previews or non-form pop-ups `ProDialog`: Content is organized through default slots or named slots. |
configuration form `ProForm`fields are described by `ProFormField[]`and support existing controls such as input, selection, dictionary, upload, and rich text. |
: Dictionary Selection and Display; `Dict`, `DictLabel`: Registered as global components by the core startup process. |
: Image upload: `UploadImg`: core's publicly available upload component; The upload of multiple images and files is currently only available for internal use by core. |
: Tree Filtering: `TreeFilter`: Supports static data or request loading, single selection and multiple selection. |
: Icon selection `SelectIcon`: Select the Element Plus icon name. |
: Markdown read-only Preview; `MarkdownPreview`: Encapsulated `md-editor-v3`, unified security cleaning, code highlighting, light and dark themes, and compact code block styles. |
: Rich text: `WangEditor`: Encapsulate wangEditor and reuse file upload services. |
: Password Strength: `PasswordStrength`: Login, User and Personal Center password form usage. |

, `CronExpression`, `ECharts`, `Grid`, `ImportExcel`, `SelectFilter`, and `SwitchDark`do exist. However, it has not yet been opened through npm `exports`and should only be used within core. Whether cross-package references are possible is subject to `frontend/admin/packages/core/package.json#exports`. The source code directory cannot be used as a public interface.

## Public Import entry

business module uses the core package public entry and does not reference `packages/core/src`:

```ts
import ProTable from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/ProTable";
import FormDialog from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/Dialog/FormDialog.vue";
import MarkdownPreview from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/MarkdownPreview/index.vue";
import type {
  ColumnProps,
  HeaderActionProps,
  ProTableInstance
} from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/ProTable/interface";
import type {
  ProFormField,
  ProFormInstance
} from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/ProForm/interface";
```

is as follows:

: Component: npm entry
| --- | --- |
| `FormDialog`| `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/Dialog/FormDialog.vue`|
| `ProDialog`| `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/Dialog/ProDialog.vue`|
| `DictLabel`| `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/Dict/DictLabel.vue`|
| `MarkdownPreview`| `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/MarkdownPreview/index.vue`|
| `PasswordStrength`| `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/PasswordStrength/index.vue`|
| `ProForm`| `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/ProForm/index.vue`|
| `ProTable`| `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/ProTable`|
| `SelectIcon`| `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/SelectIcon/index.vue`|
| `TreeFilter`| `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/TreeFilter/index.vue`|
| `UploadImg`| `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/Upload/Img.vue`|
| `WangEditor`| `@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/components/WangEditor/index.vue`|

`bootstrapAdminApp`will also globally register the Element Plus icon as well as `Dict`, `DictLabel`, and `SvgIcon`. Global registration facilitates the direct use of templates, but it does not mean that the corresponding source code path has become a public entry point for npm.

## Lists and forms

### ProTable

`ProTable`is defined in `packages/core/src/components/ProTable/interface/index.ts`. Common configurations include:

- `columns`: Column, search term, dictionary, status, and row operations.
- `requestApi`: Pagination request, returns `{ data: { list, total } }`.
- `headerActions`: Add, batch delete and other header operations.
-`cellType`: Currently, there are cells `image`, `status`, `actions`, and `money`.
-`dictCode`: Display or search using the system dictionary.

page request uses core's table tool to convert pagination parameters:

```ts
import { buildPageRequest } from "@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core/table";

async function requestTable(params: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const response = await service.PageResource(buildPageRequest(params));
  return {
    data: {
      list: response.resources ?? [],
      total: response.total
    }
  };
}
```

table instance offers capabilities such as re-requesting, searching, resetting, clearing selections, and reading the current selection and paging status. The specific type is subject to `ProTableInstance`.

### ProForm and FormDialog

`ProFormField`currently supports input boxes, numbers, segment selection, checkboxes, switches, pullers, single selection, multiple selection, dictionaries, tree selection, dates, Cron, shuttles, image and file uploads, rich text, dynamic lists, key-value lists, and custom slots.

only need to disclose the component and field types:

```vue
<FormDialog
  ref="dialogRef"
  v-model="dialogVisible"
  :model="formModel"
  :fields="formFields"
  :rules="rules"
  @confirm="handleSubmit"
  @closed="resetForm"
/>
```

`FormDialog`is only responsible for the interaction and verification entry, and does not automatically call the business interface. The page executes `validate()`in the confirmation event, submits the service, closes the pop-up window and refreshes the table. After closing, the model and validation status are explicitly reset.

## Markdown preview

`MarkdownPreview`is used for read-only content such as project documentation, database migration instructions, and AI responses. Components uniformly inject local highligh.js within core, clean the rendering results with DOMPurify, generate anchor points compatible with Chinese and duplicate titles, and disable Mermaid, KaTeX, ECharts, image zooming, code folding, and line numbers of code.

```vue
<MarkdownPreview
  :model-value="content"
  :is-dark="globalStore.isDark"
  max-code-height="360px"
/>
```

`modelValue`is the original Markdown text, `isDark`follows the host theme, and `maxCodeHeight`only limits the maximum height of long code blocks. Single-line and double-line code blocks are always highly rendered based on their actual content. Business modules are no longer allowed to directly rely on the underlying `md-editor-v3`or maintain another set of Markdown themes.

## 内部组件

以下组件是现有实现，但未列入公共 npm 入口：

\ ndirectory \ ncapabilities \ n
| --- | --- |
: `components/Card`: Data Overview card. |
: `components/CronExpression`: Six-segment Cron editing. |
: `components/ECharts`: Bar, Line, Pie and other chart containers. |
; `components/ErrorMessage`; 403, 404, 500 and other error status displays. |
: `components/Grid`, `SearchForm`: Responsive layout of the ProTable search area. |
: `components/ImportExcel`: Excel file import pop-up window. |
: `components/Loading`: Page and full-screen loading status. |
: `components/SelectFilter`: Multiple sets of filtering conditions. |
: `components/SwitchDark`: Switch between light and dark themes. |
: `components/Upload`: Single image, multiple images, single file, multiple file upload. |

business module requires a certain capability, first confirm whether there is a public entry. If there is indeed a need for cross-module reuse, add a clear single-component entry point to `package.json#exports`in core and synchronize build and type checking. Do not add the universal export of `components/*`.

## Layout and Page components

are located in `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/layouts`: `LayoutVertical`, `LayoutClassic`, `LayoutTransverse`, and `LayoutColumns`. They are selected by core routing and global Settings and are not used as components of business pages.

System module are located at `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/views/**/components`, such as the user page department tree, personal center form, and code generation preview component. `src/components/Ai.vue`is the AI entry point for System registration to the top toolbar. None of these components currently have a public npm export.

## Application component

uni-app core provides two base components, `BootstrapStatus`and `KratosTabBar`. The public entry is based on `@liujitcn/kratos-uni-app-core/components/*.vue`. # International Design

This article describes the internationalization boundaries, runtime behavior, and data responsibilities currently implemented by the warehouse. The specific operation of adding a new language is subject to [International Language Expansion Guide ](国际化语言扩展指南.md).

## Current conclusion

| Content | Current Implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Fixed language pack | `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `en-US`, `ja-JP` |
| Compile-time default language | `zh-CN` |
| Dynamic resource master language | Determined by `base_language.is_primary` |
| Fixed copywriting | core/System JSON language pack for three front-end workspaces |
| Backend Error | Structured JSON directory for `backend/internal/i18n/assets` |
| Runtime language options | Enabled languages returned by `base_language` interface |
| Dynamic Resources | Menus, dictionaries, dictionary entries, and system configuration name/value translation tables |
| Machine Translation | Empty translations can be generated and saved on demand; existing non-empty translations will not be overwritten |

Internationalization is not about putting all language names or translation constants into the database. The database is responsible for deployment and configuration, and the language package is responsible for the whitelist and fixed copy during compilation; new languages ​​must update both layers at the same time.

## Runtime link

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Files["语言包 JSON"] --> Sync["scripts/sync_locales.py"]
  Sync --> UI["固定 UI 与错误目录"]
  DB["base_language"] --> Options["运行时语言选项"]
  Request["Accept-Language"] --> Locale["locale 规范化"]
  Locale --> UI
  Locale --> Dynamic["动态菜单/字典/配置解析"]
  Dynamic --> Tables[("翻译表")]
```

### Compile-time language collection

`scripts/sync_locales.py` scans the following seven language pack directories; the code generator copy is also stored in the back-end language directory and passes the `system.code.gen.*` prefix verification:

```text
backend/internal/i18n/assets
frontend/admin/packages/core/src/locales
frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/locales
frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/locales
frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales
frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/locales
frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales
```

The file set, fixed keys and placeholders of the seven language pack directories must be consistent; the `system.code.gen.*` key in the back-end language file is directly reused by the code generator. The script generates six front-end `generated.ts` and verifies the locale mapping of Day.js and Element Plus on the management side. Core's `resource/i18n` receives host language resources. Core is responsible for directory loading and error localization internally, and does not embed project entries. The generated files cannot be modified manually.

### Runtime language configuration

`base_language` Save:

- `language_code`: canonical BCP 47 language code;
- `language_name`, `native_name`: management terminal and login page display name;
- `status`, `sort`: whether optional and display order;
- `is_primary`: Primary language for dynamic menus, dictionaries and system configuration.

When the front end is started, it first uses the compile-time package to establish a fallback language list, and then requests the public language interface; when the database interface succeeds, it is based on the enabled language and sorting, and when it fails, it falls back to the compile-time language list. The deployment configuration should only enable languages ​​that have been published with the package, the database records themselves will not generate missing language packages.

### Requests and rollbacks

Management-side Axios, refresh token, fetch, SSE and Swagger requests, as well as uni-app/Taro requests, uploads and SSE, uniformly send standardized `Accept-Language`. The backend matches the area according to the whitelist, and the unknown value falls back to `zh-CN`.

The rollback sequence is as follows:

```text
固定 UI：当前语言 -> zh-CN -> 安全默认文案
菜单/字典/配置：当前语言非空翻译 -> 主表主语言字段 -> 稳定 code/path
错误：当前语言 message_key -> zh-CN message_key -> 原始安全消息 -> INTERNAL_ERROR
```

Do not display raw keys, unsaved machine translation results, database errors, SQL or third-party provider responses at runtime.

## Fixed copy and error directory

Each front-end module maintains its own JSON language package. The language set, key, namespace and placeholder are verified when the module is registered. Core maintains general capabilities, System maintains system management, personal center and AI copywriting; modules must not directly modify the language package of another module.

Backend error directory loaded by `kratos-core/resource/i18n`. Proto `buf.validate`'s `id/message` and explicit `WithMessageKey` in Go must be defined in `zh-CN.json`, other languages ​​keep the same keys and placeholders. The check command is:

```bash
make i18n-check
```

The error keeps the existing `code/reason` externally, only adds the stable `message_key/message_args` in the metadata, and renders `message` according to the request language by the response boundary.

## Front-end and back-end Key naming convention

The front-end and back-end use the same set of layered ideas, but retain the naming sources of their respective code ecosystems: the front-end fixed copy generates business paths from component names, and back-end errors generate business paths from Proto package and Service. Key is a stable technical identifier that does not contain Chinese characters and is not named based on translation results.

### Front-end fixed copywriting

Front-end fixed copy uses the following format:

```text
<模块>.<组件业务路径>.<文案类型>.<名称>
```

The component business path comes from `defineOptions.name`, split the PascalCase name into a lowercase dot path:

```text
BaseDict      -> base.dict
BaseDictItem  -> base.dict.item
CodeGenTable  -> code.gen.table
BaseTenant    -> base.tenant
```

Example:

```text
system.base.dict.title.create
system.base.dict.field.created_at
system.base.dict.dialog.confirm_status
system.base.dict.message.create_success
system.code.gen.table.field.page_type
```

Copywriting types use fixed sets: `title`, `field`, `section`, `action`, `placeholder`, `validation`, KR ATOSTOKEN0006, `message`, `error`, `status`, `value`, `tooltip`, `empty`. Use `snake_case` uniformly for names and fields, such as `confirm_status`, `created_at`, `create_success`.

For copywriting that is truly cross-business reusable, use `common.*`, without adding business paths repeatedly:

```text
common.action.create
common.field.created_at
common.validation.required_input
```

The logical key of the front-end language package uses the above dotted path. The current runtime and verification code are still read according to the flat key; if the JSON is changed to a nested object, the synchronization script, module registration and generated product must be modified simultaneously, and the JSON shape cannot be changed manually.

### Backend error message

Backend `message_key` uses the following format:

```text
<package 去掉版本>.<Service 业务路径>.<操作或对象>.<字段>.<规则>
```

Remove the version number from the Proto package, remove `Service` from the Service and use PascalCase to split it into a lowercase dotted path:

```text
system.admin.v1 + BaseDictService -> system.admin.base.dict
system.admin.v1 + CodeGenTableService -> system.admin.code.gen.table
base.v1 + LoginService -> base.login
```

Example:

```text
system.admin.base.dict.entity.name.required
system.admin.base.dict.create.name.required
system.admin.base.dict.update.id.required
system.admin.code.gen.table.field.page_type.required
```

`entity` represents the verification of the entity itself, and other values ​​represent specific operations. Field names and rule names use Proto style `snake_case`. Rule names should remain stable, with priority being given to fixed vocabulary such as `required`, `max_length`, `min_length`, `format`, `pattern`, `positive`, `non_negative`, `unique`, `supported`, etc.

Generic error is not bound to a specific Service:

```text
common.error.invalid_argument
common.error.permission_denied
```

The version number `v1` does not enter the key; `message_key` will be returned with the error response and is an external stable contract. The rename must be synchronized with Proto, Go, all language directories and the caller.

### Correspondence between front and back ends

The front and back ends are not required to use exactly the same key, but the business paths should be able to correspond to each other:

```text
前端：system.base.dict.dialog.confirm_status
后端：system.admin.base.dict.create.name.required
```

Dynamic menu, dictionary, configuration and other database translations use the target type and number of `base_i18n`, and do not reuse the fixed copy key.

## Dynamic resource translation

Dynamic resources share a translation table `base_i18n`, and the target resources are distinguished by `target_type`:

| `target_type` | Main table | Translatable fields |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `1` | `base_config` | Text and rich text configuration values |
| `2` | `base_config` | System configuration name |
| `3` | `base_dict` | dictionary name |
| `4` | `base_dict_item` | Dictionary entry label |
| `5` | `base_menu` | Menu title |
| `6` | `base_job` | Scheduled task name |
| `7` | `base_migration` | Migration Instructions |

`base_dict.code` and `base_dict_item.value` are stable business identifiers and do not enter the translation table; the dictionary name and dictionary item label correspond to `3` and `4` respectively, and the system configuration name and value correspond to `2` and `1` respectively.

When creating or updating dynamic resources, the main language text is written to the main table; manually entered non-main language text is written directly to `base_i18n`. Uninputted languages ​​are supplemented by translation tasks, and existing non-empty translations will not be overwritten; the main language is not repeatedly saved in the translation table, and falls back to the main table if it is missing.

Fixed translations of built-in menus, dictionaries, dictionary entries and system configurations are in version `i18n.<locale>.up.sql`. The migration uses idempotent `INSERT IGNORE`, which will not overwrite the data that has been maintained; the executed version cannot be repaired by rewriting the file, and a new version must be added for migration.

## Machine Translation

Machine translation when the service is run through `kratos-kit/translator` Press `backend/configs/translator.yaml` to select Provider. The entries include:

- Management side `BaseI18nService.DraftBaseI18n`: Generate and save a single translation for a saved menu, dictionary, dictionary item or configuration.
- After the menu, dictionary, dictionary item and configuration are successfully created or updated: the resource message is first delivered to the asynchronous translation queue; when the queue consumption fails, the scheduled task scans the pending translations.
- When the management editor submits empty text, or if a vacant translation is found when hovering the list name, it will be filled in immediately through the same interface; the manually filled non-empty translation remains unchanged.

Batch language packs and migration translations are generated by `make i18n-locale I18N_LOCALE=<locale>` calling independent scripts and are not part of the normal service request link.

The translation interface is turned off by default and can be turned on through `translator.enabled=true`, `I18N_DRAFT_ENABLED=true` or application metadata. The server reads the controlled source text, with the target language restricted to the enabled languages, calling serially and using the HTTP timeout configured by `translator.timeout` (default 8 seconds); existing non-empty translations will not be overwritten. System configuration names, text, and rich text type values ​​will enter machine translation, and images and Boolean values ​​will not be sent out.

The Provider is intended for translation only and cannot be used for login, error responses, plain CRUD, or arbitrary text translation proxies. When the Provider is unavailable, fixed language packs, existing translations, and primary language fallbacks must still work properly.

## Code generation

The code generator reuses the `common.*` general template in `backend/internal/i18n/assets/<locale>.json`, and uses `system.code.gen.*` to save the code to generate exclusive process copy and terminology; at the same time, it reads business names and field names from table-level and field-level `i18n_config`. The generation page will write the stable keys of all compilation-time languages; when the non-main language lacks necessary configurations, the missing items should be filled in and displayed in the preview before official generation.

Generators must not write new Chinese UI copy directly into Vue, Proto or menu SQL. The generated results belong to the key range of the current code generation object and cannot cover other modules or manually maintained translations.

## Database migration

New languages ​​or new translations directly complement the unique `v0.0.1` initialization migration:

```text
backend/migration/assets/v0.0.1/mysql/
├── README.md
├── README.<locale>.md
├── language.up.sql
└── i18n.<locale>.up.sql
```

`make i18n-sync I18N_MIGRATION_VERSION=v0.0.1` generates `base_language` initialization record; `make i18n-locale I18N_LOCALE=<locale>` writes dynamic translation SQL to the current `v0.0.1` by default. The generator only creates `README.md` when the directory has no description. The description of the existing directory needs to be manually updated according to the actual script; the existing `README.<locale>.md` should also be updated simultaneously. Empty files are not created when there is no corresponding language description.

The enablement status, ordering, and primary language of `base_language` are deployment configurations and should not be forcibly overridden by re-executing the language pack sync script. The database that has executed `v0.0.1` will not automatically replay the modified initialization script. Verification should use a new database or rebuild according to the development environment process.

## Verification Checklist

After adding or modifying a language, check at least:

1. `make i18n-check` and `make i18n-sync` passed.
2. The key and placeholder verification of the management end, uni-app, and Taro passed.
3. When the language interface fails, the three terminals can still use the compile-time fallback list.
4. Language selection can be restored before logging in, after logging in, refreshing and reopening the app.
5. Menus, dictionaries and configurations can all fall back correctly when there are non-empty translations, missing translations and primary language switching.
6. The reason for verification, authentication, permission and resource errors remains unchanged, only the message is localized.
7. The type check and lint of `go test ./...` and affected workspaces passed.

For step-by-step commands, file lists, and troubleshooting for adding new languages, see [International Language Expansion Guide ](国际化语言扩展指南.md).

# Internationalization Language Extension Guide

This article is the implementation manual for the new language. The current fixed language set is `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `en-US`, `ja-JP`. When adding a new language, the compile-time language package determines "what language the code can render", and the `base_language` data only determines "what languages ​​are enabled in the current deployment, how to sort them, and which language is the main language of dynamic resources."

## First understand the two levels of responsibilities

| Layer | Authoritative Source | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Compilation period | Backend error directory, three-end core/System JSON, code generation directory | Language whitelist, fixed UI copywriting, error copywriting, code generation template |
| Runtime | `base_language` table | Language name, native name, enabled status, sorting, primary language |

Therefore, just adding a language record to the database cannot make the new language appear on the page; just adding front-end JSON cannot make the dynamic menu, dictionary and login page read the language. The two layers must be synchronized.

## Files to be added

Each language code must use the JSON file with the same name in the following seven language pack directories, and the code generator copy is also merged in the backend language file:

| Table of Contents | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `backend/internal/i18n/assets` | Backend Error Message Catalog |
| `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/locales` | Management base and public copy |
| `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/locales` | Management System Copywriter |
| `frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/locales` | uni-app base and public copy |
| `frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales` | uni-app System copywriter |
| `frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/locales` | Taro base and public copy |
| `frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales` | Taro System Copywriter |
JSON keys, placeholders, and namespaces must remain unchanged. `common.language.<locale>` is used to display the language name offline and can be supplemented; the runtime name is read from the database first, so adding a new language does not require modifying the existing language package or TypeScript registration code.

## Key naming quick check

When adding fixed copy, first determine the module and component it belongs to, and then name it according to unified rules:

```text
前端：<模块>.<defineOptions.name 转换路径>.<文案类型>.<名称>
后端：<package 去掉版本>.<Service 转换路径>.<操作或对象>.<字段>.<规则>
```

Example:

```text
BaseDict -> system.base.dict.dialog.confirm_status
BaseDictService / system.admin.v1 -> system.admin.base.dict.create.name.required
CodeGenTable -> system.code.gen.table.field.page_type
```

The component name and service name are split into lowercase dot paths according to PascalCase; the end names, fields and rules use `snake_case`. Use `common.*` for cross-business public copywriting and `common.error.*` for common back-end errors. The backend key does not have `v1`; renaming `message_key` requires synchronization of Proto, Go and all language directories.

## Standard process

### 1. Select language code

Use BCP 47 form, such as `de-DE`, `pt-BR`. The language code must be consistent in all directories, and two representations of `de` and `de-DE` cannot appear at the same time. The code needs to be parsable by Core's `resource/i18n` language resource directory, and the management side's Day.js and Element Plus locale dependencies can find the corresponding region or basic language mapping.

### 2. Add language pack

Using `zh-CN.json` as the key benchmark, add `<locale>.json` to the seven directories in the above table, and translate values ​​item by item:

```text
backend/internal/i18n/assets/de-DE.json
frontend/admin/packages/core/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/uni-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/locales/de-DE.json
frontend/taro-app/packages/modules/system/src/locales/de-DE.json
```

The code generator copy is written directly to `backend/internal/i18n/assets/<locale>.json`, using the `system.code.gen.*` prefix; when adding a new code generation copy, all back-end language files are modified simultaneously, and the placeholder set is retained.

`common.language.<locale>` can be written to the management side Core language package, which is used to display the language name offline and generate the initial name for `base_language` migration; the runtime language name, sorting and enabling status are still subject to database records. Adding a new language does not require modifying the language name key in the existing language pack.

`{name}`, `{field}`, `{max}`, `{{.Value}}` placeholders as well as URL, permission paths, dictionary code/value and HTML/Markdown tags must be preserved during translation. Do not translate routes `name`, `path`, `component`, or API paths.

### 3. Run the synchronization script

Execute in the warehouse root directory:

```bash
make i18n-sync
```

The script checks for:

- Whether the file sets in the seven language pack directories are consistent;
- Whether the key set and placeholders of each language pack are consistent;
- Whether the code generator language directory field is complete;
- Whether there are available mappings for Day.js and Element Plus on the management side.

After passing the check, the script generates the following files. Do not edit them manually:

- `src/locales/generated.ts` for six front-end packages;
- Management side Day.js, Element Plus locale mapping;
- Generate `language.up.sql` and description files when passing in a migration version.

### 4. Generate database language records

The current warehouse uses `v0.0.1` for migration; this version is written when generating language initialization records:

```bash
make i18n-sync I18N_MIGRATION_VERSION=v0.0.1
```

The migration generated by the script is only responsible for supplementing the `base_language` record. Using `INSERT IGNORE` will not overwrite the enabled status, sorting and main language configuration of the existing deployment. Check the migration version directory before submitting and make sure `language.up.sql` is submitted together with the documentation.

If the deployment does not want the language to be enabled immediately, `base_language.status` can be adjusted to be disabled after migration; the main language can only be switched through the management side language configuration or database configuration, and cannot be changed through the front-end language package.

### 5. Prepare dynamic resource translation (optional)

Fixed UI and backend bugs Once the package is complete, new languages ​​can fall back to the main language at runtime. To provide fixed translations for built-in menus, dictionaries, dictionary items, and system configurations, you can use batch scripts to generate language packs and dynamic translation data:

```bash
I18N_OFFLINE=1 \
make i18n-locale I18N_LOCALE=de-DE
```

`I18N_OFFLINE=1` can be removed for online translation. This command is written to the corresponding language pack, `i18n.de-DE.up.sql` and description files under `v0.0.1` by default. Migration only writes non-empty fixed text, and existing values ​​will not be overwritten. If the language pack has been manually completed, maintain `i18n.<locale>.up.sql` directly, and do not use this command to overwrite the manual translation.

Dynamic resources can also be edited in the management end internationalization maintenance page. The main language text with content in the form can be translated instantly individually or in batches. The Draft interface only returns a single translation and does not write it into the unified internationalization table; manual input will be directly saved to the unified internationalization table. Empty translations enter the asynchronous internationalization queue after the resource is successfully created or updated. When submitting empty texts, they will also be completed according to the save logic. Failure messages will be scanned again by the scheduled task, and existing non-empty translations will not be overwritten. The internationalization interface is only available when `I18N_DRAFT_ENABLED=true` or equivalent application metadata is enabled. The system configuration name and text and rich text type values ​​support internationalization. Pictures and Boolean values ​​are not sent out; when the runtime value is missing, it falls back to the main language.

### 6. Verify and submit

It is recommended to execute before submitting:

```bash
make i18n-check
make i18n-sync
git diff --check

cd backend && go test ./...
cd ../frontend/admin && pnpm type:check && pnpm lint:oxlint
cd ../uni-app && pnpm tsc && pnpm lint
cd ../taro-app && pnpm tsc && pnpm lint
```

Confirm that the new language is available in the following scenarios: first startup, language switching before login, switching after login, refresh recovery, dynamic menu, dictionary display, verification error and main language fallback when dynamic translation is missing.

## Contents that do not need to be modified

Adding new languages ​​does not require modification:

- Go locale constants, backend service registration and error localization code;
- Three terminals locale runtime, module registration and request encapsulation;
- Proto, RPC makefile and menu routing code.

These runtime files read the front-end registration files generated by compile-time language packs and synchronization scripts; the runtime enabled languages, default languages, and ordering are provided by the `base_language` database record. Corresponding dependencies or code changes are only required when a new language exposes that the basic library does not have locale mapping, the language package structure requires new fields, or the business does add a new translation key.

## Troubleshooting

| Phenomenon | Check |
| --- | --- |
| `语言集合不一致` | Whether all seven language pack directories have the same name JSON |
| `语言键集合不一致` | Compare key and placeholder with same directory `zh-CN.json` |
| `代码生成器语言键集合不一致` | Are the `system.code.gen.*` keys and placeholders of each backend language file consistent |
| `缺少组件语言映射` | Does Day.js/Element Plus provide this regional or base language file |
| The language can be switched but the name is empty | Check the `base_language` record, or add `common.language.<locale>` |
| Menu/Dictionary still shows the main language | Check whether there is a non-empty record in the unified translation table, and whether the request is sent `Accept-Language` |

For the complete architecture description, see [Final Internationalization Solution ](国际化最终方案.md); for local constraints of the language pack directory, see the README of each directory.

# Security strategy and operation and maintenance tasks

## Login security

Login policies are saved by global, tenant, and user scope. There is one policy for each scope, and the black and white list restrictions under the policy are saved one by one according to the rules; only matching enabled policies will participate in the runtime judgment, and the failed lock and password validity period parameters will be overridden in order of user, tenant, and global, and source restrictions will be superimposed. Login failure lockout, password expiration, and source restrictions are not enforced when there are no matching enabled policies.

When the policy is enabled, fields `max_failed_attempts`, `lock_duration_minutes`, and `password_max_age_days` control login failure lockout and password expiration respectively; `password_max_age_days` is set to `0` to disable password expiration. These fields have no effect when the policy is not enabled.

MAC restriction matches the `X-MAC-Address` request header provided by the client, the real network card MAC cannot be read in normal HTTP; zone restriction matches the `X-Region-Code` request header injected by the trusted gateway, the gateway must sanitize external forged values.

The password policy is configured by the global, tenant and user scopes of `BaseLoginPolicy`. New, reset and personal modifications uniformly read the effective policy for the current account. Password complexity is calculated based on four types of characters: lowercase, uppercase, numbers, and symbols.

The password policy fields are as follows:

| Field | Default Value | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `password_min_length` | `8` | Minimum number of characters |
| `password_history_count` | `3` | The number of retained historical passwords that are prohibited from being repeated. `0` means not enabled |
| `password_min_complexity_classes` | `3` | At least the number of lowercase, uppercase, numbers, and symbol categories that meet |
| `password_max_age_days` | `90` | Password validity period, `0` means not enabled |
| `initial_password` | Not configured | Used when a new user does not submit a password; the user must change the password when logging in for the first time |

## Current session

`BaseSessionService` provides an interface for viewing the current session and canceling all sessions. When logging in, the server records the session creation time, token issuance time, source address, device and last business activity time; the management API request updates the activity time, and the refresh token request does not extend the idle time. Default idle timeout is 30 minutes, absolute lifetime is 12 hours, configured by `authn.session`.

## Audit log

Core writes the request and policy events to `Core 日志事件流`, and then the Core consumer drops them into `base_api_log` and `base_policy_evaluation_log` respectively; the Admin business events write into the independent `admin.log.event`, and the Admin consumer drops them into the database. The six complete log model and automatic migration are still provided by Admin. All six types of logs are asynchronously entered into the database. If the queue fails, the request thread will not write to the database synchronously. Ordinary tenants are not granted log menu and query permissions.

When the Admin log buffer is closed/full, the queue is unavailable, or the delivery fails, the fixed file name `admin-log.jsonl` is written according to the hidden system configuration `baseLogFallback.file_path`, and file synchronization is performed; each record uses the runtime key service to generate an HMAC based on the `kratos-admin:base-log-fallback/integrity` derived key. The log warehousing rollback file is rewritten to the log table every day by the `system.admin.BaseLogFallback` task, and independent log storage and alarms should be configured. The data access log extracts the returned field range, record number, and sensitive field touch ID from the real Proto response; it does not forge SQL, table names, or SQL fingerprints when there are no data layer facts.

Log storage rollback parameters are stored in the hidden system configuration `baseLogFallback`, which is maintained uniformly by the system configuration service and refreshes the cache in real time. The configuration structure is as follows:

```json
{
  "file_path": "./logs/base-log-fallback"
}
```

After enabling the scheduled task `system.admin.BaseTableArchive`, read the table archiving configuration enabled in `base_table_archive` at 03:30 every day, and archive the data that exceeds the online retention period to the current data source archive table or OSS by table; online records will be deleted only if the archive verification is successful and the configuration allows it. File rotation and compression of normal application logs is handled by `kratos-kit/logger`.

## Database backup

The database backup policy is saved in `base_table_backup`, and the database connection reuses `data.database` or `data.databases` in the startup configuration; the enablement status and retention quantity are maintained according to the data source record. `system.admin.BaseTableBackup` is executed at 02:00 every day. The backup integrity key and encryption key are derived from the runtime key service at `kratos-admin:backup/integrity` and `kratos-admin:backup/encryption` respectively, and are no longer injected through the service process environment variable:

`base_table_backup.status` controls whether to execute, `base_table_backup.retention_count` controls the number of reservations; the backup is uniformly compressed, encrypted and uploaded to OSS.

The task will use AES-256 to encrypt the backup and upload it to OSS, and at the same time write SHA-256, HMAC and object information to `base_table_backup_record`; the task will read back the OSS object for verification before marking it as successful, and the recovery process will reject backups that are missing or failed to verify. Backup and recovery are controlled by the service program, and the keys are not injected through the service process environment variables, nor appear in the command line parameters.

Restore unified execution via management side `BaseTableBackupRestoreService.ExecuteBaseTableBackupRestore`. The program will download the verified backup object from OSS and complete integrity verification, decryption, decompression and import; business writing must still be stopped before recovery, and an isolation environment must be used to complete the recovery drill.

OAuth client credentials are stored encrypted using a separate `kratos-admin:oauth/credential-protection` derived key; JWT key rotation does not reuse this key.
After upgrading to this policy, historical plaintext OAuth clients need to regenerate keys through the management side "Rotate Client Credentials", and the system is no longer compatible with old plaintext credentials.

## Object Storage

File Service reuses Core's OSS adapter, supporting `local`, `aliyun`, `minio` and `s3`. Single-instance development uses `local` by default. `root_directory` of the local OSS is mapped to the `/data/` static resource path; the uploaded object is saved as `业务类型/文件分类/年/月/日/文件名`, and the object path is saved in the database. Multi-instance deployments should switch to MinIO/S3 compatible storage and use configured root and least privilege credentials. MinIO in Compose is started using the `object-storage` profile.

The upload entry limits the number, size, and extension of files, verifies that the extension is consistent with the server-side sniffing MIME, and rejects executable or embeddable types such as HTML, SVG, PHP, and Flash. The production environment can configure ClamAV-compatible scanning commands through `oss.upload_security`; if the file first enters the external quarantine and is scanned by the gateway, `SECURITY_EXTERNAL_FILE_SCAN=true` can be declared while retaining quarantine, scan results, and release logs.

## Production safety verification

Standalone services started with `prod` or `production` will verify the security baseline before database initialization. Statements of external capabilities include:

| Variables | External capabilities and necessary evidence |
| --- | --- |
| `SECURITY_TLS_TERMINATED` | Reverse proxy or load balancing TLS configuration, certificate, and protocol scan results |
| `SECURITY_DATABASE_TLS_TERMINATED` | Database agent or service mesh link encryption configuration |
| `SECURITY_REDIS_TLS_TERMINATED` | Redis proxy or service mesh link encryption configuration |
| `SECURITY_EXTERNAL_BACKUP` | Backup strategies, off-site copies, recovery drills, and RPO/RTO records |
| `SECURITY_EXTERNAL_LOG_ARCHIVE` | SIEM/WORM Retention Policy, Access Control and Integrity Evidence |
| `SECURITY_EXTERNAL_FILE_SCAN` | Quarantines, Malware Scanning Policies, and Clearance Logs |

When it is not undertaken by an external platform, archiving and backup strategies should be configured in `base_table_archive` and `base_table_backup`, log warehousing rollback should be configured in hidden configuration `baseLogFallback`, and scan commands should be configured in `oss.upload_security`. Production verification only prevents obvious misconfigurations and cannot replace grade guarantee evaluation, penetration testing and operation and maintenance systems.

The default request body limit of ordinary HTTP API is 64 MiB and the processing timeout is 30 seconds, which are configured by `server.http.max_body_bytes` and `server.http.timeout`. `/events`, `/mcp` and AI message flows do not set request timeouts by default and are only protected by the HTTP request body limit; file uploads also have independent 20 MiB single file and 20 file limits.

documents.content:
# Open License Design

open license is used for external development interfaces. It does not replace the user login on the management end, nor does it reuse the third-party login `OauthService`. The external development interface uses the `/api/v1/oauth/`path prefix. The management end maintains the client through `OauthClientService`.

only provides authorized client management and token issuance, and does not have an inbuilt `/api/v1/oauth/`business interface. The access party needs to contribute Proto, OpenAPI and services with this path prefix through an external Go module. When external business modules are not connected, the list of authorized apis on the management end is empty, and the client cannot use it to call business interfaces.

management page is located at `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/views/base/oauth-client`, where you can query authorization apis, create/edit/delete clients, start and stop clients, and copy full credentials. The complete credentials are only read on demand at the management end. `client_secret`and `crypto_key`do not enter the list response.

## Data model

only adds the `oauth_client`table:

- `client_id`, `client_secret`: Client credentials.
- `tenant_id`: The client binds to the tenant, and all client data and Token permissions use the data permissions of this tenant.
-`crypto_type`, `crypto_key`: The encrypted metadata of the caller protocol is read and decrypted by an open authorization HTTP Filter before the request binding.
-`ip_whitelist`: Comma-separated precise IP or CIDR.
-`api`: The JSON array of `base_api.operation`that is allowed to be accessed, without creating an associated table, and consistent with the menu API fields.
- `status`: Client start and stop status.

## Protocol process

1. The client submits `client_id`, `client_secret`and the optional `grant_type=client_credentials`to `POST /api/v1/base/oauth/client/token`.
2. Service verification credentials and client status, issue Bearer tokens using the existing JWT/Redis Token manager; The role code of the Token is `client_id`. `uid/rid`uses a negative client identity space to avoid conflicts with the user token cache key. When binding the default tenant, use the OAuth-specific tenant code to avoid bypassing data isolation by the cross-tenant management semantics of the default tenant.
3. When the management end creates or modifies a client, it converts the JSON API list into the Casbin operation policy of the client role under the default tenant.
4. The client carries the Bearer Token and calls the `/api/v1/oauth/`interface. HTTP OAuth middleware is executed only when the token role hits `oauth_client.client_id`, verifying the client's identity, status, source IP, and whether the current operation + HTTP method is in the API JSON whitelist respectively.
5. Ordinary user tokens will not hit the client table and will directly follow the existing user authentication and Casbin links.

## Data Encryption and decryption

client is created, the management end will generate a matching format `crypto_key`according to the algorithm:

: `crypto_type`: `crypto_key`format: Ciphertext format:
| --- | --- | --- |
: `sm4`:16-byte key encoded in Base64: Base64(`12 字节 nonce || ciphertext || 16 字节 GCM tag`)
: `aes`:32-byte key encoded in Base64: Base64(`12 字节 nonce || ciphertext || 16 字节 GCM tag`)

is as follows:

1. Call `POST /api/v1/base/oauth/client/token`, and use `client_id`and `client_secret`to obtain the Bearer Token.
2. For the requests of `POST`, `PUT`, and `PATCH`under `/api/v1/oauth/`, encrypt the normal JSON request body according to the client's algorithm and then encode it in Base64 Sent as the entire HTTP body; The query/path parameters of `GET`and `DELETE`remain in plaintext.
3. Requests must carry `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. The server first verifies the client Token, then reads the client algorithm and key, and decrypts before Proto HTTP body bind. Therefore, the business Service still receives the ordinary request object.
4. Successful 2xx responses will be encrypted. The current ProtoJSON direct response is encoded as Base64 ciphertext in the form of a JSON string. If the access party uses `{"code":200,"data":...}`to wrap the response, only the `data`field will be encrypted, while `code`and `msg`will remain in plaintext.
5.4xx /5xx error response is not encrypted to facilitate the location of credentials, IP, permissions or ciphertext format errors.

HTTP Filter is registered at `backend/internal/module/module.go`. The HTTP wrapper implementation is located at `backend/internal/server/middleware/oauth/crypto.go`, and the algorithm implementation is in its `crypto/`subdirectory. It is located on the outer layer of the generated Proto HTTP route; operation Service middleware cannot be used only because the request body has been bound when the latter is executed.

## boundary

API option, the save checksum, and the runtime interceptor will all reject interfaces that are not `/api/v1/oauth/`to prevent the management side, application side, or basic login interface from being authorized to the development client. After deactivating, modifying the whitelist or deleting the client, new requests are immediately affected. Delete and clean up the Casbin policy simultaneously.

client only needs to save the `client_id`, `client_secret`, `crypto_type`and `crypto_key`returned by the management end. Do not write `crypto_key`to the front-end repository or log. Updating the client algorithm will regenerate the key, and the old key will immediately become invalid. The client should re-read the credentials before initiating the call.
