documents.content:
# Interface parameter verification

uses `buf.validate`to declare rules, and the Core's `server/middleware/validate.go`invokes protovalidate in HTTP and gRPC business processing. When the verification fails, return `INVALID_ARGUMENT`, and the response boundary localizes the first violated `message`according to the requested language. The error reason and metadata remain stable.

management end `ProForm`is used for real-time interactive prompts and cannot replace server-side verification. The constraints at both ends should express the same business rule. `rules`

## Proto writing style

```proto
import "buf/validate/validate.proto";
import "gnostic/openapi/v3/annotations.proto";

message ExampleForm {
  string name = 1 [
    (gnostic.openapi.v3.property) = {description: "名称"},
    (buf.validate.field).cel = {
      id: "example.name.required"
      message: "请输入名称"
      expression: "this.size() > 0"
    },
    (buf.validate.field).cel = {
      id: "example.name.max_len"
      message: "名称不能超过 30 个字符"
      expression: "this.size() <= 30"
    }
  ]; // 名称
}

message CreateExampleRequest {
  ExampleForm example = 1 [
    (gnostic.openapi.v3.property) = {description: "示例表单"},
    (buf.validate.field).required = true
  ]; // 示例表单
}
```

uses the stable `<resource>.<field>.<rule>`, and Chinese messages are directly directed to users. Don't rely on the default English error of the generator.

## Common Rules

Constraint Proto
| --- | --- |
: String required; CEL `this.size() > 0`:
; maximum length; CEL `this.size() <= 30`
positive number ID CEL `this > 0`
: Required for nested messages: `(buf.validate.field).required = true`
; enumeration legal; `(buf.validate.field).enum = {defined_only: true}`
; List not empty; CEL `this.size() > 0`
: List Unique; CEL `this.unique()`:
; email: `(buf.validate.field).string.email = true`
| URL | `(buf.validate.field).string.uri = true`|
regular expression: `(buf.validate.field).string.pattern = "..."`
set of values: `(buf.validate.field).string.in = ["a", "b"]`

cross-field rules are written at the message level:

```proto
message PeriodForm {
  option (buf.validate.message).cel = {
    id: "period.range"
    message: "结束时间不能早于开始时间"
    expression: "this.end_at >= this.start_at"
  };

  int64 start_at = 1 [(gnostic.openapi.v3.property) = {description: "开始时间"}]; // 开始时间
  int64 end_at = 2 [(gnostic.openapi.v3.property) = {description: "结束时间"}]; // 结束时间
}
```

, the existence of foreign keys, tenant permissions, protected resources, and state transitions depend on the database or the current identity. It must be placed in biz and cannot be disguised as format verification.

## ProForm

```ts
const fields: ProFormField[] = [
  {
    prop: "name",
    label: "名称",
    component: "input",
    props: { maxlength: 30, showWordLimit: true },
    rules: [
      { required: true, message: "请输入名称", trigger: "blur" },
      { max: 30, message: "名称不能超过 30 个字符", trigger: "blur" }
    ]
  }
];
```

- `required`, length, range, format and list quantity are provided with instant prompts on the front end.
Control restrictions such as
-`maxlength`, `min`, and `max`should be consistent with rules and Proto.
- The business verification message returned by the back end remains the final result. The front end must not skip error handling just because the form verification has been passed.
The
-`optional`field only executes the format rule when it has a value. The non-mandatory fields on the front end should not unconditionally add `required`.

## Change Check

1. Modify Proto comments, OpenAPI description, and `buf.validate`.
2. Execute `make -C backend api`and `make i18n-openapi`.
3. Execute `make -C frontend ts-admin`, `make -C frontend ts-uni-app`or `make -C frontend ts-taro-app`on the consumer end; Execute `make -C frontend ts`when three ends need to be generated at once.
4. Synchronize ProForm rules, control restrictions, and interface error displays.
5. Perform backend tests and corresponding front-end type checks.

are not modified manually.

# Database and Initialization data

## Current data source

uses the MySQL database `kratos_admin`. The basic configuration is located at `backend/configs/data.yaml`, and the difference in the development environment is at `backend/configs/data.dev.yaml`. Redis is used for caching states such as verification codes, one-time password keys, and tokens.

`data.database`indicates a single default data source; `data.databases`can declare multiple named data sources. The default data source saves the system table and the execution records of `base_migration`for all modules.

## Table creation and migration

is:

1. Create all GORM clients.
2. Execute the registration model of `AutoMigrate`for the client of `enable_migrate: true`.
3. Load module migration resources and execute `.up.sql`by dependency, version, database type, and data source.
4. Synchronize the existing multilingual descriptions in the migration directory to the unified translation table.
5. Complete the synchronization of OpenAPI interface data, tenant role menu and Casbin policy.

`enable_migrate`only controls GORM to automatically create tables and does not disable `v0.0.1`to initialize SQL. The new environment should enable it as the default data source; otherwise, tables like `base_migration`may not exist yet.

## Resource structure

Basic initialization resource directory:

```text
backend/migration/assets/v0.0.1/mysql/
├── README.md
├── README.en-US.md
├── README.ja-JP.md
├── README.zh-TW.md
├── base_area.up.sql
├── default_data.up.sql
├── i18n.en-US.up.sql
├── i18n.zh-TW.up.sql
└── i18n.ja-JP.up.sql
```

splits and uses GORM to automatically migrate and create the `base_user_mfa`, `base_user_mfa_totp`, `base_user_mfa_webauthn`and `base_user_mfa_recovery`tables. The open license client uses GORM to automatically migrate and create the `oauth_client`table. The default MFA policy, authentication method, open authorization menu /API, and administrator permissions are directly written into the initialization script of `v0.0.1`.

. The directory rules are as follows: `v0.0.1`

```text
assets/v0.0.1/<database-type>/<feature>.up.sql
assets/v0.0.1/<database-type>/README.md
assets/v0.0.1/<database-type>/README.<locale>.md              # 可选
assets/v0.0.1/<database-type>/<data-source>/<feature>.up.sql
assets/v0.0.1/<database-type>/<data-source>/README.md
assets/v0.0.1/<database-type>/<data-source>/README.<locale>.md # 可选
```

built in and verified as `mysql`. The direct files in the database type directory belong to the `default`data source. The first-level subdirectory is the named data source and must be consistent with the configuration name. Scripts are executed in order of file names. `base_migration.description`only reads `README.md`in the same directory. If you need to connect to other database types, you still have to add the corresponding database type directory under `v0.0.1`. Do not add a new version directory.

`README.<locale>.md`synchronize to `base_i18n`with `base_migration.id`as the target ID and `I18N_TARGET_TYPE_BASE_MIGRATION_DESCRIPTION`as the target type. When language files exist, update the corresponding translation based on the file content. Do not add or modify the language record when it does not exist. The details interface prioritizes returning the translation of the requested language. If it is missing, it reverts `base_migration.description`.

, includes modules, data sources, and versions. If any upgrade script within a version fails, it will roll back that version and prevent the service from starting. After the repair and restart, it will retry the unrecorded version.

## Initialize the content

`default_data.up.sql`is provided together with the script of the same version language:

- Default tenant, department, position, role, and development accounts `super`and `admin`.
- System configuration, dictionary, menu, button and service method permission relationships.
- Management end System page, AI, code generation, API documentation and application end required permission entry.
-MFA Policy and authentication method Dictionary, as well as open authorization client management menu and API option permissions.

`default_data.up.sql`is responsible for language logging, default business data, menus and permissions; The same version of `i18n.{locale}.up.sql`provides non-primary language translations of menus, dictionaries, dictionary entries, system configuration names/values, and scheduled task names through `base_i18n.target_type`. After the migration is completed, Core writes `README.<locale>.md`to `base_i18n`. The Admin details interface directly queries this table. The main language is configured by `base_language.is_primary`. The main table saves the text of the main language, while other enabled languages are saved to the unified translation table. The translation table and code generation `i18n_config`field is created by GORM `AutoMigrate`.

`base_area.up.sql`provides regional basic data. Initialize SQL using `INSERT IGNORE`. When encountering an existing unique key record, skip it and do not overwrite the existing data.

starts up, `BaseApiCase.InitializeOpenAPI`reconstructs the interface metadata based on the registered OpenAPI, then synchronizes the tenant administrator menu and reconstructs the Casbin rules. Therefore, when modifying the Proto path or the menu API list, it is necessary to simultaneously regenerate the OpenAPI and update the `v0.0.1`initialization SQL.

## New environment

```sql
CREATE DATABASE kratos_admin CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
```

, the default development account is:

- `super / 112233`
- `admin / 112233`

are only for local initialization and must be modified before deployment.

## Initialize the change

- All the initialization data, default data, menus, interface permissions and translations required for the table structure of the new features are uniformly completed to the full initialization state of `v0.0.1`.
- Directly modify the corresponding script and instructions under `backend/migration/assets/v0.0.1/mysql`; No new `v0.0.2`or higher, also not increase the stock of incremental `.up.sql`/ `.down.sql`library.
- For new languages, generate language packs according to the [International Language Extension Guide ](国际化语言扩展指南.md) and write the initialization SQL to `v0.0.1`; for dynamic fixed translations, still use `i18n.<locale>.up.sql`
-SQL maintains idempotence, avoiding `TRUNCATE`, unconditional full table updates or deletions.
- The database that has recorded `v0.0.1`will not be automatically replayed due to the modification of the initialization script. When verifying the initialization content, use a brand-new database or rebuild it according to the development environment process.

documents.content:
# Log and audit design

> Status: Six types of queries, correlation audits, asynchronous buffering, menus and archiving tasks have been implemented; fault drills continue to be improved.
> Date: 2026-08-31.
> This design is not compatible with the old `base_log` query interface, and historical logs will not be migrated; during implementation, the new initialization data of `v0.0.1` shall prevail.

## 1. Design conclusion

The log audit is split into six independent tables. No common log parent table is created, and different facts are no longer mixed together through a `log_type` field:

```text
base_login_log
base_api_log
base_operation_log
base_data_access_log
base_permission_log
base_policy_evaluation_log
```

Each table records only one immutable fact:

| Table | Questions Answered | Typical Producers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `base_login_log` | Who attempted authentication how and what the outcome was | Login, logout, refresh token, MFA, OAuth |
| `base_api_log` | Which protocol request what happened | HTTP/gRPC Unified Access Middleware |
| `base_operation_log` | Who did what to which business object | Business Case or Operational Audit Interceptor |
| `base_data_access_log` | Who accessed what data, and what was the scope of the impact | Data access layer, export/download/query service |
| `base_permission_log` | What changes have occurred in the permission configuration | Roles, menus, APIs, user permission services |
| `base_policy_evaluation_log` | How the authentication engine determines allow or deny | Authentication engine decorators such as Casbin/OPA |

`base_job_log` continues to exist as a scheduled task execution log, but it does not belong to the six types of security audits; the operation log file does not fall into these six tables.

## 2. Common constraints

### 2.1 Events are immutable

- The audit table is only appended and does not provide an editing interface.
- The management terminal only provides paging, details and filtering, but does not provide new, modified or deleted buttons.
- `updated_at` is not used; `created_at` represents the drop-out time, and `occurred_at` represents the event occurrence time.
- After the retention period expires, it will be archived by the background or cleaned in batches based on time, and will not be deleted through the ordinary tenant API.
- Log writing failure only records indicators and operation logs, and cannot change the original business request or authentication results.

### 2.2 Tenants and principals

- `tenant_id` is used to associate, filter and isolate data with the current business table.
- `tenant_code` must be retained as well, as currently Casbin uses the tenant encoding as the policy domain.
- `user_id`, `user_name`, `role_id`, `role_code` are snapshots when the event occurred, and historical information cannot be restored by relying on subsequent association tables.
- If the login fails, the user or tenant ID may not be parsed. In this case, the subject field is allowed to be empty, but the entered tenant code, account name, and client information should be saved.
- Ordinary tenants do not have log menu, query API or details API permissions; only platform administrators can query cross-tenant records.

### 2.3 Sensitive data

Logging of passwords, access tokens, refresh tokens, private keys, CAPTCHA answers, full cookies, and unmasked request bodies is prohibited.

- Only desensitized summaries are retained in the request body and response body; large fields are not included in the library.
- The business snapshot only retains fields that allow auditing. Password, Token, key, verification code and other fields are deleted or replaced with `[REDACTED]`.
- The policy input saves `input_hash` and the necessary masking digest, not the full user attributes, request headers, or SQL conditions.
- SQL in data access logs can only save desensitized text and fingerprints; policy evaluation logs do not save `scope_sql`.

## 3. Six table structure

The field type is subject to MySQL, and the actual model is generated by GORM automatic migration; this design does not create new table SQL.

### 3.1 `base_login_log`

Authentication fact table, recording each key node of the authentication process, instead of only recording successful login.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `bigint` | Primary Key |
| `tenant_id` | `bigint NULL` | Tenant ID when resolution is successful |
| `tenant_code` | `varchar(64)` | Tenant encoding in request or token |
| `user_id` | `bigint NULL` | Successfully parsed user ID |
| `user_name` | `varchar(128)` | Account name snapshot |
| `login_type` | `tinyint` | Password, OAuth, MFA, refresh token, logout |
| `result` | `tinyint` | Success, failure, exception |
| `reason_code` | `varchar(64)` | Stability failure reason classification |
| `reason` | `varchar(500)` | Reasons after desensitization |
| `client_ip` | `varchar(64)` | Client IP |
| `user_agent` | `varchar(1024)` | User-Agent |
| `device_id` | `varchar(128) NULL` | Client device identification |
| `request_id` | `varchar(64) NULL` | Request ID |
| `trace_id` | `varchar(128) NULL` | Link Tracking ID |
| `occurred_at` | `datetime(3)` | Authentication event time |
| `created_at` | `datetime(3)` | Log storage time |

Index:

- `idx_base_login_log_tenant_occurred_at (tenant_id, occurred_at)`
- `idx_base_login_log_user_occurred_at (tenant_id, user_id, occurred_at)`
- `idx_base_login_log_result_occurred_at (tenant_id, result, occurred_at)`
- `idx_base_login_log_ip_occurred_at (client_ip, occurred_at)`
- `idx_base_login_log_request_id (request_id)`, `idx_base_login_log_trace_id (trace_id)`

### 3.2 `base_api_log`

Protocol access fact table. It records the technical results of the request and does not infer whether the business action actually occurred.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `bigint` | Primary Key |
| `tenant_id` | `bigint NULL` | Current Tenant ID |
| `tenant_code` | `varchar(64) NULL` | Current tenant number |
| `user_id` | `bigint NULL` | Operator User ID |
| `user_name` | `varchar(128) NULL` | Operator Name Snapshot |
| `request_id` | `varchar(64)` | Request ID |

## 4. Enumeration

The enumeration is only placed in the Proto file that actually uses it, and each enumeration value must have Chinese comments:

| Enumeration | Recommended values ​​|
| --- | --- |
| `BaseLoginLogType` | `UNSPECIFIED`、`PASSWORD`、`OAUTH`、`MFA`、`TOKEN_REFRESH`、`LOGOUT` |
| `BaseLogResult` | `UNSPECIFIED`、`SUCCESS`、`FAILURE`、`ERROR` |
| `BaseOperationAction` | `UNSPECIFIED`、`CREATE`、`UPDATE`、`DELETE`、`PUBLISH`、`REVOKE`、`IMPORT`、`EXPORT`、`OTHER` |
| `BaseDataAccessType` | `UNSPECIFIED`、`LIST`、`DETAIL`、`QUERY`、`EXPORT`、`DOWNLOAD`、`IMPORT` |
| `BasePermissionTargetType` | `UNSPECIFIED`、`USER`、`ROLE`、`MENU`、`API`、`TENANT` |
| `BasePermissionAction` | `UNSPECIFIED`、`GRANT`、`REVOKE`、`CREATE`、`UPDATE`、`DELETE`、`ASSIGN` |
| `BasePolicyEvaluationType` | `UNSPECIFIED`、`IS_AUTHORIZED`、`FILTER_PAIRS`、`FILTER_PROJECTS` |
| `BasePolicyDecision` | `UNSPECIFIED`、`ALLOW`、`DENY`、`ERROR` |

`reason_code` uses strings instead of large cross-table enumerations; the reason is extended by the specific authentication engine or business module, but only error semantics mapped to project freezes are allowed externally.

## 5. Event writing responsibility

```text
认证流程              -> base_login_log
协议请求中间件         -> base_api_log
业务 Case              -> base_operation_log
数据访问/导出层        -> base_data_access_log
角色/菜单/API 权限变更  -> base_permission_log
鉴权 Engine 装饰器      -> base_policy_evaluation_log
```

### 5.1 Request link

The same request can produce multiple different facts, but each one is only written to the table to which it belongs:

```text
请求进入
  -> base_api_log
  -> base_policy_evaluation_log
  -> base_data_access_log（实际访问数据时）
  -> base_operation_log（实际发生业务变更时）
```

Permission configuration changes are only written to `base_permission_log` and are no longer copied to `base_operation_log` at the same time; API requests and authentication facts are still retained separately.

### 5.2 Policy evaluation record granularity

- `IsAuthorized` produces one record per actual engine call.
- Multi-tenant or multi-principal loops evaluate tenant/principal records as they actually are, retaining the same `request_id` and `trace_id`.
- `FilterAuthorizedPairs`, `FilterAuthorizedProjects` records the aggregation results without writing a separate line for each candidate.
- Each real `IsAuthorized` engine call is recorded. The time-consuming only covers the engine call and does not include subsequent business processing.
- Writing uses asynchronous buffering or batch queues, and log failures cannot cause authentication to fail.

### 5.3 Core audit event processing (completed)

Core delivers access and policy facts to `Core 日志事件流` through `Core 日志流水线`, and then the Core consumer writes `base_api_log` and `base_policy_evaluation_log` respectively. The Admin business middleware uses an independent `admin.log.event` queue to write login, operation, data access and permission logs by the Admin consumer. Admin continues to provide six full GORM models and is responsible for automatic migration, Core only uses a streamlined internal model write of API/policy logs, and does not register or migrate models.

The following conditions must not occur:

- The same request writes both `base_log` and `base_api_log`;
- `base_log` continues to display six types of logs as the "System Log" menu;
- New policy evaluation records disguised as authorization logs via `base_log.log_type`.

The Admin middleware is responsible for business facts such as login, operation, data access and permissions and asynchronously enters the database on its own; API and policy evaluation facts are collected, delivered and entered into the database asynchronously by Core. Log delivery errors when the queue is unavailable and do not fall back to the old deleted table.

All six types of audit logs are asynchronously loaded into the store: the request thread only performs non-blocking delivery to the bounded in-process buffer, and the background work coroutine then completes desensitization, serialization and Redis queue IO; only consumers of `Core 日志事件流` and `admin.log.event` can call the log Store. The consumer maps the stable queue message number to the log primary key, and the same message is treated as existing when it is re-delivered after successful writing to the database but ACK failure. When the buffer is full, the queue is unavailable, or event serialization fails, only the running log is recorded. Blocking requests or synchronous rollback of writing to the library are not allowed.

## 6. Responsibility boundaries between Core and Admin

### 6.1 `kratos-core` is responsible

- Defines the generic `LogEvent`, event type, desensitization context and `LogEmitter/LogSink` interface.
- Collect API request facts at the HTTP/gRPC transport layer.
- Collecting authentication permission/denial and policy evaluation in the authorization middleware is time-consuming; the rejection result must be collected before the middleware returns early, and the login result is recorded by the Admin business middleware.
- Delivers and consumes `Core 日志事件流` via `Core 日志流水线`, using the reduced internal model to write `base_api_log` and `base_policy_evaluation_log`.
- Remove the hardcoding of `logging.Server` on `models.BaseLog` and remove the queue service's forced dependency on `BaseLogRepository`.

Core does not rely on Admin business models such as `base_login_log`, `base_permission_log`, etc., nor does it provide log menus and management pages.

### 6.2 `kratos-admin` is responsible

- Define a complete GORM model of six `base_*_log` tables, which is responsible for model registration, automatic migration and repository query.
- Deliver and consume `admin.log.event`, asynchronously writing login, operation, data access and permission logs.
- Provides six groups of read-only Proto, query service, management page, menu and administrator permissions.
- Keep `base_job_log` as the Core task execution log; it does not fall under the category six security audit.

### 6.3 Target data flow

```text
Core HTTP/gRPC 与认证/授权采集
  -> Core Core 日志流水线 进程内缓冲
Core Core 日志流水线 后台工作协程
  -> Core 日志事件流
  -> Core API/策略日志 Store
Admin 业务 Case 采集操作/数据/权限事实
  -> Admin LogSink 进程内缓冲
Admin LogSink 后台工作协程
  -> admin.log.event
  -> Admin 登录/操作/数据访问/权限日志 Repository
```

### 6.4 Cross-warehouse implementation sequence

1. Add `Core 日志流水线` to `kratos-core`, responsible for queue delivery and asynchronous warehousing of API/policy events, and remove the old `base_log` queue contract and warehousing.
2. Admin registers six complete models and is responsible for automatic migration; Admin itself registers `admin.log.event` consumer and writes the remaining four types of logs asynchronously.
3. Admin deletes `BaseLogService`, `BaseLogCase`, local `base_log` model/Repository, old pages and menus; `OpsMonitoring` changes to `base_api_log`.
4. `v0.0.1` in Admin retains six categories of menus and permission initialization, without adding increments or creating table SQL.
5. Complete the generation, testing and Redis/MySQL joint debugging of Core and Admin.

## 7. Proto, service and management side

Each table corresponds to a read-only management service, and all service names use the `Base` prefix:

| Table | Proto Service | Management HTTP Prefix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `base_login_log` | `BaseLoginLogService` | `/api/v1/admin/base/login-log` |
| `base_api_log` | `BaseApiLogService` | `/api/v1/admin/base/api-log` |
| `base_operation_log` | `BaseOperationLogService` | `/api/v1/admin/base/operation-log` |
| `base_data_access_log` | `BaseDataAccessLogService` | `/api/v1/admin/base/data-access-log` |
| `base_permission_log` | `BasePermissionLogService` | `/api/v1/admin/base/permission-log` |
| `base_policy_evaluation_log` | `BasePolicyEvaluationLogService` | `/api/v1/admin/base/policy-evaluation-log` |

In addition to the six single-table services, `BaseLogService` only provides cross-log table public correlation query `GetBaseLogTrace`, which does not correspond to specific tables.

The first version of each service only provides:

- `PageBaseXxxLog`: Filter by time, tenant, user, result and resource;
- `GetBaseXxxLog`: View details after desensitization.

`BaseLogService.GetBaseLogTrace` Aggregates six types of audit records by `request_id` or `trace_id`. The management end displays the API, authentication, data access and business facts of the same request according to the timeline in any log details.

Does not expose the `Create` HTTP API. Internal writing uses an independent writer/repository to avoid the audit interface being called by ordinary clients.

It is recommended that the management page be split into six menu pages. The list page reuses the table and detail drawer components, but each page uses its own Proto, fields and query interface. The policy evaluation page additionally displays the authentication engine, evaluation type, resources, actions, decisions, and time consumption.

## 8. Menu ID planning

The six types of logs are hung in the `91040000` "Log Audit" directory; scheduled tasks use an independent `91050000` directory; the upgrade history is directly hung in the system management root directory as `91990000`. New installations do not respect old menu IDs and do not provide compatibility mapping.

| ID | Parent ID | Type | Path | Component | Title | Sort |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| `91040000` | `91000000` | Directory | - | - | Log Audit | 130 |
| `91040100` | `91040000` | Menu | `base/login-log` | `system/base/login-log/index` | Login Log | 1 |
| `91040200` | `91040000` | Menu | `base/api-log` | `system/base/api-log/index` | API Access Log | 2 |
| `91040300` | `91040000` | Menu | `base/operation-log` | `system/base/operation-log/index` | Operation log | 3 |
| `91040400` | `91040000` | Menu | `base/data-access-log` | `system/base/data-access-log/index` | Data Access Log | 4 |
| `91040500` | `91040000` | Menu | `base/permission-log` | `system/base/permission-log/index` | Permissions Log | 5 |
| `91040600` | `91040000` | Menu | `base/policy-evaluation-log` | `system/base/policy-evaluation-log/index` | Strategy Evaluation Log | 6 |
| `91050000` | `91000000` | Directory | - | - | Scheduled tasks | 140 |
| `91050100` | `91050000` | Menu | `base/job` | `system/base/job/index` | Task Management | 1 |
| `91050200` | `91050000` | Hide menu | `base/job/log` | `system/base/job/log` | Scheduled task log | 2 |
| `91990000` | `91000000` | Menu | `base/migration` | `system/base/migration/index` | Upgrade History | 150 |

The detail buttons uniformly use the `01` suffix of the menu ID:

```text
91040101  查询登录日志详情
91040201  查询 API 访问日志详情
91040301  查询操作日志详情
91040401  查询数据访问日志详情
91040501  查询权限日志详情
91040601  查询策略评估日志详情
91050101  查询定时任务日志详情
```

The audit details button is bound to `GetBaseXxxLog` and `BaseLogService.GetBaseLogTrace` of the corresponding service; the scheduled task log details are only bound to `GetBaseJobLog`. The menu itself is bound to the corresponding paging interface.

Role scope:

- Super administrator: Has full log permissions through the super administrator built-in policy.
- Platform Administrator: owns `91040000`, `91050000`, `91990000` and their submenus and buttons.
- Tenant administrators, ordinary users, and authenticated users: do not add the above logs, tasks, and upgrade menus.

## 9. `v0.0.1` modification range

Only modify the existing `backend/migration/assets/v0.0.1/mysql` initialization resource:

1. `default_data.up.sql`: Replace the old system log menu under `91040000` and write the new menu ID, component, API permissions and administrator role menu set.
2. `i18n.*.up.sql`: Update the log menu title and detail button title according to the new menu ID; do not add dynamic internationalized data to the log table fields.
3. Do not add `v0.0.2`, `v0.0.3` or other incremental directories.
4. Do not write table creation or cleaning statements such as `CREATE TABLE`, `ALTER TABLE`, `DROP TABLE`, `DELETE`.
5. The six tables are created by the GORM automatic migration model; the migration resources are only responsible for menu, API and role initialization.
6. Old `base_log` data is not considered, nor is compatibility with old interfaces provided.

## 10. Implementation sequence

```text
冻结本文档
  -> 在开发库建立六张空表并执行 gorm-gen
  -> 定义六组 Proto 并生成 Go/OpenAPI/TS
  -> 实现六个只读 Service/Case/Repository
  -> Core 投递并消费 API/策略事件，使用宿主已初始化的日志表入库
  -> 接入登录、API、操作、数据、权限、策略评估写入器
  -> 实现六个管理端页面
  -> 修改 v0.0.1 菜单、按钮、角色集合和 i18n
  -> 运行生成、测试、lint、i18n 校验
```

Core no longer creates or writes `base_log`; the six types of audit facts are carried by the Admin split table.

# Login and password encryption

This article records the account password, verification code, OAuth, MFA, password ciphertext and Token mechanism currently shared by the management side, uni-app and Taro. The interface is based on `backend/api/proto/base/v1/login.proto`, `oauth.proto`, and `mfa.proto`.

## Login with account and password

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant UI as 前端
  participant API as Backend
  participant Cache as Redis
  UI->>API: GET /api/v1/base/config
  UI->>API: GET /api/v1/base/captcha
  UI->>API: POST /api/v1/base/captcha/verify（行为验证码）
  UI->>API: GET /api/v1/base/password-public-key?scene=LOGIN
  API->>Cache: 保存一次性私钥，TTL 5 分钟
  UI->>UI: RSA-OAEP + AES-GCM 加密密码
  UI->>API: POST /api/v1/base/session
  API->>Cache: 消费验证码和一次性私钥
  API-->>UI: access_token / refresh_token / expires_in
  UI->>API: GET 当前端 profile
```

When the tenant code is not passed, the backend uses the default tenant. The account number is queried by `tenant_code + user_name`; there is currently no branch logged in by the independent `phone` field.

Ordinary verification code submits `captcha_id` and the user's answer directly. Verification codes for sliders, clicks, rotations, etc. first call `/api/v1/base/captcha/verify` to get a one-time `captcha_token` valid for 2 minutes, and then submit the token as the login `captcha_code`.

## Password protocol

Algorithm ID:

```text
RSA-OAEP-256+A256GCM
```

1. The front end requests a one-time RSA public key for the specified scenario.
2. The frontend executes `trim()` on the password, generating a 32-byte AES-256 key and a 12-byte GCM IV.
3. AES-GCM encryption password, RSA-OAEP(SHA-256) encryption AES key.
4. Base64 encoded and submitted `key_id`, `nonce`, `algorithm`, `encrypted_key`, `iv`, `ciphertext`.
5. Backend verification scenario, nonce and algorithm, read and immediately delete the private key from Redis, decrypt it and compare the database password hash with `go-utils/crypto.Verify`.

One-time key TTL is 5 minutes and is deleted once read. The same ciphertext cannot be replayed; if a retry fails, the public key must be retrieved and encrypted again.

The management end and the two application ends preferentially use Web Crypto in the security context; when H5 is accessed through HTTP or the running environment does not have Web Crypto, `asmcrypto.js` statically introduced by the respective bases is used to implement the same RSA-OAEP (SHA-256) + AES-GCM protocol. The uni-app WeChat applet continues to use `wx.getRandomValues` and WeChat Base64 API to avoid dynamic import compatibility issues in the applet environment.

The pure JavaScript fallback only solves the running compatibility when the browser lacks Web Crypto, and is not equivalent to HTTPS: HTTP may still be actively tampered with, and the access/refresh token in the login response may also be obtained by network listeners. Production environments and unmanaged networks must still use HTTPS.

## WeChat Mini Program OAuth

The application side `MP-WEIXIN` uses provider `wechatmini`:

1. `wx.login()` obtains one-time code and submits `/api/v1/base/oauth/session`.
2. When bound, the backend returns the authentication result according to the MFA policy; when automatic registration is allowed and unbound, the user is first created and authentication continues.
3. When it is not bound and automatic registration is not allowed, `binding_required=true` is returned, and the page displays the tenant, user name, password and digital verification code.
4. When the user submits the binding form, he must call `wx.login()` again and then request `/api/v1/base/oauth/binding/session`; the backend first verifies the verification code, account password and new code, then writes the binding in the transaction and generates the login authentication status. Repeated submission of the same WeChat account by the same user is idempotent, and it will be rejected if it has been bound by other users.

The WeChat code can only be used once, and the same code cannot be reused for detection of binding status and formal binding.

The response of the binding interface continues to follow `LoginStatus`, and MFA will not be skipped directly because "the binding relationship is written":

- `AUTHENTICATED`: Save the access/refresh token, load the profile, and enter the original target page.
- `MFA_REQUIRED`: Do not save the temporary token, use TOTP, WebAuthn or recovery code to call `/api/v1/base/mfa/verify`; after successful verification, save the official token and enter the original target page.
- `MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED`: Do not issue a formal token, use `mfa_setup_ticket` to call `/api/v1/base/mfa/enrollment` to obtain the binding parameters, then call `/api/v1/base/mfa/enrollment/confirm` to complete the factor binding and display the recovery code only once. The WeChat applet then goes through `wx.login()` again and enters `MFA_REQUIRED`. The login is completed only after the user completes the factor verification.

If the binding request returns an error, the binding relationship will not be dropped; in this way, you can safely retry after repairing the verification code, password or MFA configuration without being blocked by the legacy "WeChat account has been bound" status.

The management side also supports OAuth provider list, authorization jump, callback, binding list and unbinding; the specific provider is configured by `backend/configs/oauth*.yaml`.

## Token

The login response contains `token_type`, `access_token`, `refresh_token`, and `expires_in`. The HTTP request sets both the `kratos_refresh_token` HttpOnly Cookie and the `kratos_refresh_exp` expiration prompt cookie that does not contain sensitive information; the management end only persists the access token and user information, and uses cookies first when refreshing. uni-app/Taro can still read the refresh token in the response body and should use platform-secure storage instead.

The application request layer calls `POST /api/v1/base/token` when the access token remains no more than 5 minutes, and concurrent refreshes share the same Promise. `refresh_token` can be omitted in the request body, and the server will read and rotate the refresh token from the HttpOnly Cookie. Failure to refresh will clear the local login status; logging out will delete the cached authentication information corresponding to the access/refresh token, cookies, and refresh token.

After the management side disables or deletes a user, resets the password, or adjusts the user role relationship, the backend will revoke the user's existing access/refresh token to prevent the old authentication load from continuing to access.

Backend user creation, reset and personal modification passwords are all verified against the currently effective `BaseLoginPolicy`. When a created user does not submit a password, the backend uses the initialization password hash in the matching policy; the user's login response is `PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED`, and the password must be changed first. The initialization password is only saved in hash form, and the policy details will not return the original value.

Public authentication requests use `authMode: "none"` or equivalent configuration, and do not carry the old `Authorization`; requests that require login automatically add Token.

## Multi-factor authentication

System configuration of the management side and application side `securityMfaMethod` selects `totp` or `webauthn`, `securityMfaPolicy` selects `disabled`, `optional` or `all_required`. The runtime parameters are loaded via the `mfa` node for `backend/configs/mfa.yaml` or `mfa.dev.yaml`, where the TOTP binding must be configured with `encryption_key` (base64 encoded 32-byte key). TOTP uses Authenticator dynamic password and one-time recovery code. When disabled, it verifies the current password and dynamic password or recovery code; WebAuthn uses browser Passkey or security key to complete registration and login ceremony. When disabled, it verifies the current password and one-time Passkey or recovery code. The serverRedis saves the short-term challenge and saves the credential public key and signature counter at `base_user_mfa_webauthn`. Production environments should manage this configuration via KMS, Vault, or Secret Manager and maintain the same encryption keys across reboots.

The policy and authentication method with the same name on the management side and the application side take effect according to stricter values ​​to avoid lowering the security requirements of the administrator or application side through the forged `source-client` request header. The semantics of `disabled`, `optional` and `all_required` are respectively not requiring MFA, optional binding and verification at login, and unbound users who must enter the binding process after logging in. When the WeChat applet does not support WebAuthn, bound users can use a one-time recovery code to log in; WebAuthn binding needs to be completed on a client that supports Passkey. Enabling or disabling MFA will revoke existing sessions for that user; TOTP recovery codes are only displayed once after being generated.

## Key entry

| Domain | Path |
| --- | --- |
| Login Proto | `backend/api/proto/base/v1/login.proto` |
| OAuth Proto | `backend/api/proto/base/v1/oauth.proto` |
| MFA Proto | `backend/api/proto/base/v1/mfa.proto` |
| Backend login | `backend/internal/biz/base/login.go` |
| Backend OAuth | `backend/internal/biz/base/oauth.go` |
| Backend MFA | `backend/internal/biz/base/mfa.go`, `backend/internal/service/base/v1/mfa_service.go` |
| Key generation and decryption | `backend/internal/biz/base/utils/password_crypto.go` |
| Management side password encryption | `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/utils/passwordCrypto.ts` |
| Management WebAuthn | `frontend/admin/packages/core/src/utils/webauthn.ts`, `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system/src/views/profile/components/security.vue` |
| uni-app login and password encryption | `frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/views/pages/login/login.vue`, `frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/utils/passwordCrypto.ts` |
| uni-app WebAuthn | `frontend/uni-app/packages/core/src/utils/webauthn.ts` |
| Taro login and password encryption | `frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/views/pages/login/login.tsx`, `frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/utils/passwordCrypto.ts` |
| Taro WebAuthn | `frontend/taro-app/packages/core/src/utils/webauthn.ts` |
| Application-side Token and request | `packages/core/src/utils/auth.ts`, `http.ts` of the two application-sides |

When troubleshooting login failure, check the configuration, verification code, public key, ciphertext scenario, login response, token saving and profile request in sequence. Do not record clear text passwords, private keys, full tokens, or verification code answers in logs or documents.

# kratos-admin Design of the in-site messaging and notification center

Status: Design and implementation record. The current function has been integrated.
> ** Facts ** are from the current source code or external first-hand materials; The "suggestion" is about the selection and rejection of this project.
> This article records the design boundaries, implementation status, and acceptance key points, and does not replace the project's generation chain and `v0.0.1`initialization migration.

## 1. Scope and Conclusion

should be "database inbox + asynchronous audience expansion + SSE's best effort to wake up", not a chat system, and SSE delivery cannot be regarded as business success.

```text
管理员/业务发布
  -> MySQL: Message + Dispatch 同事务
  -> Redis Streams: 仅投递 dispatch_id
  -> Consumer: 分批解析受众、幂等写 Delivery
  -> SSE: 通知在线客户端 inbox.changed
  -> Client: 回查 Summary/Page，MySQL 为最终事实
```

核心决策：

1. Four new business tables of `Category/Message/Dispatch/Delivery`have been added.
2. Dispatch simultaneously undertakes the audience rules, Transactional Outbox, execution lease, and fan-out cursor.
3. Delivery uses `read_at/revoked_at/archived_at/deleted_at`to express orthogonal states instead of a single SENT/READ state.
4. Classification uses independent tables to carry display information and notification policies; The category name, title and body text should not be written in `base_i18n`.
5. User API set `base.v1.NotificationService`; Manage the API for `system.admin.v1.BaseMessageService`and `BaseMessageCategoryService`.
6. Business release via `pkg/notification.Publisher`; Business operations are not allowed to directly double write to the database and Redis.
7. Use the current Redis Streams Queue and do not introduce Asynq.
8.Admin /H5 uses a shared SSE; The first phase of wechat Mini Programs will use onShow refresh and short polling.

includes administrator drafts, scheduled/immediate release, retraction, and delivery progress. Designate all users, roles, departments, positions, and tenants; User pagination, details, read/unread, All Read, archived and personal hidden; Three-terminal unread and real-time refresh.

does not include private chat/group chat, input status, delivery receipt, external email and SMS channels, user notification preferences, any HTML/ script, precise one-time commitment, and cross-tenant message sharing.

business module only constructs `notification.Message`and invokes `notification.Publish`. The publishing end uses tenant, source and idempotent key plagiarism checking, mandatorily requires at least one audience and verifies the text format. Once the database is successfully submitted, it is regarded as a successful publication. If the queue wake-up fails, the recovery task will make up for it.

## 2. External research conclusion

### 2.1 Redis Streams

** Fact ** : `XREADGROUP`places the delivered but unconfirmed message into PEL. After successful processing, `XACK`is required; Timeout messages can be claimed. `XAUTOCLAIM`is equivalent to an automated PEL scan and claim. `XADD MAXLEN ~`will approximately trim old entries and cannot guarantee that unconfirmed loads will never be lost.

来源：

- <https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/xreadgroup/>
- <https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/xack/>
- <https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/xautoclaim/>
- <https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/xadd/>

** Suggestion: **Queue only stores location information; Dispatch must be capable of rebuilding tasks after Stream messages are lost, duplicated, or trimmed. The handler only returns nil after a database batch is successful.

### 2.2 Outbox and idempotence

** Fact ** : AWS Transactional Outbox uses the same transaction to write business data and Outbox, and then forwards them in the background, solving the problem of double writing to the database and broker. Its documentation clearly requires consumers to handle repetition and pay attention to the sequence. Azure also recommends atomically saving objects and events, background relays, and absorbing reprocessing with stable message ids/idempotent consumption.

来源：

- <https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/cloud-design-patterns/transactional-outbox.html>
- <https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/databases/guide/transactional-out-box-cosmos>
- <https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/patterns/idempotent-consumer>

** Suggestion: **Message and Dispatch are the same transaction; Publish the API and return "PUBLISHING" without waiting for the major broadcast to complete. The unique index absorbs the Queue for reinvestment.

### 2.3 Peak shaving and real-time connection

** fact: **Azure Queue-Based Load Leveling uses queues to smooth bursts; Competing Consumers process independent messages in parallel with multiple consumers, but they are idempotent and take order into account.

来源：

- <https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/patterns/queue-based-load-leveling>
- <https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/patterns/competing-consumers>

** Fact ** : WHATWG SSE defines auto-reconnection, `id/retry/Last-Event-ID`; The MDN description comments can be kept alive, and the number of HTTP/1 same-origin connections is very low, making it suitable for reusing single connections.

来源：

- <https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html>
- <https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events/Using_server-sent_events>

** Suggestion: **SSE only sends change signals; After reconnection, always check the Summary/Page. Last-Event-ID is only used for short-term optimization.

### 2.4 Inbox, Security and Three-Terminal

** Fact ** : GitHub separates Read, Done, Save, and Unsubscribe, and supports filtering/grouping; GitLab's To-Do supports Done, Undo, Snooze, batch processing, and removes the To-Do when resource access rights disappear.

来源：

- <https://docs.github.com/en/subscriptions-and-notifications/how-tos/viewing-and-triaging-notifications/managing-notifications-from-your-inbox>
- <https://docs.gitlab.com/user/todos/>

** Suggestion: ** Separate read from archive; The first issue of archive expresses Done; Re-verify the target resource permissions when clicking the notification action.

** Fact ** : OWASP suggests that the tenant context comes from the authentication session, the query uses tenant_id + resource_id, and the cache key carries the tenant; Untrusted content should be prioritized for encoding output. Only when HTML is truly necessary should sanitization be performed.

来源：

- <https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Multi_Tenant_Security_Cheat_Sheet.html>
- <https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Cross_Site_Scripting_Prevention_Cheat_Sheet.html>

** Fact ** : wechat `wx.request`collects chunks through `enableChunked/onChunkReceived`, not a browser EventSource; Taro and uni-app also mark enableChunked as a wechat Mini Program capability.

来源：

- <https://developers.weixin.qq.com/miniprogram/dev/api/network/request/wx.request.html>
- <https://docs.taro.zone/docs/apis/network/request/>
- <https://uniapp.dcloud.net.cn/api/request/request.html>

** Suggestion: ** The AI active stream continues to chunked; The first phase of the in-site message mini-program does not maintain the full director request. The H5 conditional branch uses fetch SSE.

## 3. Local status quo

- `backend/bootstrap.go`has exposed QueueConsumers and Streams; Admin has registered the `base.message.dispatch`consumer and recovery task.
-Dispatch establishes a 5-minute database lease between `lock_token`and `locked_until`. Claim, progress write-back, and failure write-back all verify the lease token. Recovery tasks only re-queue waiting, pending processing, and expired running tasks.
- `data.redis`When not empty, `kratos-kit/queue.NewQueue`actually selects Redis Streams, even if the memory queue exists simultaneously as configured.
- Currently, the default Redis consumer group is `redisqueue`, and the default hostname of the consumer; visibility 60 seconds, reclaim 1 second, concurrency 10.
- Locally implement recycling with `XPENDING + XCLAIM`. After success, `XACK + XDEL`.
- When the producer is not explicitly configured, the StreamMaxLength defaults to 1000 and is approximately trimmed. Large broadcasts cannot rely on it to save all to-do items.
-`kratos-core/data.Transaction`can now enable multiple Repo to share transactions through context.
-`base_user`has tenant/role/dept/post; The message body is saved in `base_message.content`.
-Admin already has `fetch-event-source`with Authorization, Accept Language and shared connection.
-uni-app /Taro's AI: H5 Fetch SSE, wechat Mini Program chunked; There is no global notification flow yet.
Both SSE entry points of
-Core hard reject `user/authuser`: Independent resolver and `SSE.Serve`.
- Currently, `SSEStream.Resolve(channelID,userID)`is missing tenant/role/ full Principal.
-transport supports Last-Event-ID/Event.ID, but Core `PublishJSON`does not set an ID. replay is only within the process and has a TTL of 300 seconds.

## 4. Domain Model and Four Tables

### 4.1 `base_message_category`

platform has a unified message classification maintained by the default tenant administrator. The message body and receipt records are still isolated by tenant:

: Field Group: Suggested
| --- | --- |
Identifier: id, code
display: name, icon, color, sort
: Default Policies: default_priority, retention_days, allow_archive, allow_delete
: Lifecycle: status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at

约束与索引：

- `unique(code)`;" `code`is a stable identifier used for business release and does not change with its name.
- `(status,sort,id)`.
- the default classification suggests the SYSTEM/SECURITY/TASK/BUSINESS; Do not copy classified rows for each tenant, nor use `tenant_id=0`pseudo-shared rows.
- Disabling only blocks the use of new messages and does not affect historical messages; When there is already a Message reference, deletion is prohibited; only disabling is allowed.
-`retention_days=0`indicates the adoption of the system's default retention period. Security classification can prohibit personal archiving or deletion.

### 4.2 `base_message`

logical message and frozen content:

: Field Group: Suggested
| --- | --- |
: Attribution: id, tenant_id, source_type, source, idempotency_key, payload_hash
: Sender: sender_type, sender_id, sender_name
: content:, priority, title, content, content_format
: action: action_type, action_target, action_params JSON
life cycle: status, scheduled_at, published_at, revoked_at, expires_at

### 4.3 `base_message_dispatch`

### 4.5 Classification and Content Format

- The category name is saved in `base_message_category.name`, and the icon and color are uniformly provided by the category table.
-Message saves the main text of the title and body. Do not write the message category, title, or body to `base_i18n`.
-`base_i18n`continues to only carry dynamic resources such as existing system configurations, dictionaries, menus, tasks, and migration instructions.
- The main text supports PLAIN_TEXT, SAFE_MARKDOWN and RICH_TEXT; RICH_TEXT only allows whitelist HTML generated by the editor and must be cleaned before display.

## 5. State Machine

```text
Message:
DRAFT -> SCHEDULED -> PUBLISHING -> PUBLISHED -> REVOKED/ARCHIVED
DRAFT ----------publish----------> PUBLISHING
SCHEDULED --cancel--> DRAFT
PUBLISHING --revoke--> REVOKED

Dispatch:
WAITING -> PENDING -> RUNNING -> PENDING(下一批) -> SUCCEEDED
RUNNING -> PENDING(next_retry_at) / FAILED
WAITING/PENDING/RUNNING -> CANCELLED
FAILED -> PENDING(人工重试)
```

-PUBLISHING stated that the reliable to-do list has been submitted but the audience has not fully expanded.
"
-PUBLISHED" indicates that all dispatches were successful and does not mean that the user received online.
- When partial Dispatch fails, the Message remains published and displays the progress of the failure.
- REVOKED update Delivery.revoked_at in the same transaction by message_id to ensure that queries and unreads are immediately excluded; If the stress test proves that the large broadcast batch update lock holding is unacceptable, then introduce REVOKING and batch convergence states.

## 6. Proto and release interface draft

### 6.1 `base.v1.NotificationService`

unified prefix `/api/v1/base/notification`:

- `PageInbox`: GET, cursor pagination; The view INBOX/UNREAD/ARCHIVED can be filtered by category/priority.
- `GetNotification`: GET `/{delivery_id}`.
- `GetInboxSummary`: GET `/summary`, return unread_total, category_unread, latest_delivery_id.
-`MarkRead/MarkUnread`: PUT/DELETE `/{delivery_id}/read`.
-`MarkAllRead`: PUT `/read`, request with `before_delivery_id`watermark to prevent new messages from being marked during execution.
-`Archive/Restore`: PUT/DELETE `/{delivery_id}/archive`.
-`DeleteNotification`: DELETE `/{delivery_id}`, only set personal deleted_at.

user API does not accept tenant_id/user_id; All are derived from the authentication context.

### 6.2`system.admin.v1.BaseMessageService`

unified prefix `/api/v1/admin/base/message`:

- `PageBaseMessage/GetBaseMessage/CreateBaseMessage/UpdateBaseMessage/DeleteBaseMessage`, delete only allows drafts.
- `PublishBaseMessage/ScheduleBaseMessage/CancelBaseMessageSchedule/RevokeBaseMessage/RetryBaseMessageDispatch`.
-Form contains the main content, audiences, and version.
-Detail returns the Message count and the status, cursor, attempt, and desensitization error of each Dispatch.

are split into list/get, create/update/delete, publish/schedule, revoke and retry.

### 6.3 `system.admin.v1.BaseMessageCategoryService`

unified prefix `/api/v1/admin/base/message-category`: `PageBaseMessageCategory/GetBaseMessageCategory/CreateBaseMessageCategory/UpdateBaseMessageCategory/DeleteBaseMessageCategory/SetBaseMessageCategoryStatus`; Before deletion, check the Message reference. The referenced category returns a CONFLICT. The classification is maintained only by the default tenant administrator, and other tenants can only read it.

### 6.4`pkg/notification.Publisher`

Narrow interface `Publish(ctx, Command) (messageID,error)`;" Command includes tenant, source, idempotency, categoryCode, priority, content, action, audiences, expiresAt. Publisher resolves platform-enabled categories within the transaction by categoryCode without exposing to the business caller.

-ctx joins the same transaction when it has been bound; otherwise, it creates its own transaction.
- Success only indicates that Message/Dispatch has been committed.
- Return the existing ID with the same idempotent key and the same content; Return a CONFLICT if the content is different.
- Business cannot directly `queue.AddQueue`or spell SSE stream ID.

## 7. Transactions, Queues and fan-out

publish transaction:

```text
BEGIN
insert Message(PUBLISHING/SCHEDULED)
insert Dispatch(PENDING/WAITING) per audience
COMMIT
best-effort wake Relay
```

Relay scans PENDING, expired WAITING, lease expired RUNNING, and delivers to stream `base.message.dispatch`:

```json
{"dispatch_id":123,"tenant_id":1,"expected_version":7}
```

Consumer single batch process:

1. Load Dispatch/Message by id+tenant; The final state task is directly ack.
2. CAS acquires database lease; The old version or RUNNING that has not expired will not be advanced.
3. Press `tenant_id AND user.id > cursor ORDER BY id LIMIT batch_size`to check the user ID.
4. Within a transaction batch insert - ignore Delivery, according to the real new rows in a database cursor/count/version/status, repeat Delivery will not repeat accumulate statistics.
5. After submission, try your best to send it to SSE; If there is a next batch, we will do our best to join the team again.
6. When joining the team fails, Dispatch is still PENDING, and Relay is used for supplementary casting.
After the handler successfully returns, the Core executes XACK+XDEL.

will first release the lease and enter PENDING, and then log off in increments of 1, 2, 4, and 8 minutes. After the fifth attempt fails, it enters "FAILED", and the management end manually retries and resets the count of this round of attempts. The recovery task only scans the expired `next_retry_at`and does not hot loop to preempt tasks that have not reached the retry time.

initial batch_size 500; The handler target is less than half of the visibility timeout. The default global concurrency of Queue is 10. The valid concurrency of in-station messages is first limited to 2 to 4, and then adjusted after pressure testing.

is released, the audience selector is frozen. The specific members are determined during the asynchronous fanout query, and the written Delivery never changes with the role/department. If the product requires a strict "member snapshot at the moment of click to publish", it is necessary to add member history or materialize all users first. This issue does not commit to this. Multiple Selectors overlapping are de-duplicated by the Delivery unique key.

## 8. SSE Authorization and reliability

cannot simply reject the user/authuser of Core; otherwise, App users may subscribe to the operation and maintenance flow.

, construct the Principal: user_id, tenant_id/code, role_id/code, terminal, session/token, expires_at; All from verified tokens.

evolves `Resolve(channelID,userID)`into the equivalent `AuthorizeAndResolve(request,principal,channelID)`:

Flow Strategy
| --- | --- |
: base.notification: Any authenticated user; The server derives tenant+user stream
: codegen: Background user and task owner:
: ops-monitoring: Background user with corresponding Operation/Casbin permissions
: runtime-console: Background user with runtime log permission

independent `/events`resolver and Proto `SSE.Serve`must reuse the same license implementation.

client only transmits `stream=base.notification`. The server generates `base.notification:{tenant_id}:{user_id}`and does not accept the target user channel.

- Use the Authorization header and do not include tokens in the URL.
-401/403 does not retry; Network error logout and reconnection.
- Single connection keeps alive for 20-30 seconds. Set the maximum connection lifetime and re-authenticate before the token expires.
- Event `inbox.changed`contains only change_type, delivery_id, and message_id; The client debounce and then returns to the source.
- Currently, the replay is only in memory and the Publisher does not have Event.ID. The first issue is not guaranteed to be correct by Last-Event-ID.

, the Consumer node may not necessarily hold user connections. Phase 2: Redis Pub/Sub can be used to broadcast `notification.changed`to all application nodes, and each node will only push local connections. The Pub/Sub loss is still repaired by database reconciliation. The same Queue consumer group cannot be used for node broadcasting.

## 9. Multi-tenancy and content security

- All Delivery queries are automatically authenticated with tenant_id+user_id; There is no or unauthorized unified RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.
- Ordinary tenant administrators can only select the user/role/dept/post of this tenant.
- When the super administrator broadcasts across tenants, it creates an independent Message for each tenant without using tenant_id=0.
- The cache key must contain tenant+user, and the cache will never participate in authorization.
- Re-authenticate the target resource when VIEW_KEY/URL is clicked.
- It is recommended that only VIEW_KEY be opened for the first phase. The stable viewKey is mapped through the three-terminal module and does not accept component file paths.
- title maximum 200, content recommended maximum 20KB; The action JSON is limited by depth, key-value length and total size.
- Uncleaned `v-html`, `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, javascript/data urls are prohibited; Rich text display must undergo HTML cleaning. If external links are open, only HTTPS allow-list is allowed.
- The log does not record tokens, complete body text, sensitive action parameters, or complete user arrays.

## 10. Three-terminal UX

Universal: badge 99+; The list is paginated by the cursor in reverse order by Delivery ID; All/Unread/archived; Classification screening; Batch read; Details show the source, time and clear action. read and archive are independent, and the source is returned after the status of multiple devices changes.

Admin: Header bell + Last 5 Popover + View all; A shared SSE; The management page continues to use `ProTable + FormDialog + ProForm`. Drafts are editable. Once published, they are read-only and display the Dispatch progress/retry if failed.

uni-app: System module self-contained pages, apis and unread stores; "My" display entry and badge; H5 uses fetch SSE; Wechat `onShow`, login completed, return to the front desk, enter the message page to refresh. When the page is visible, it will be polled for 30 to 60 seconds, and the background will stop. core does not rely on notification services.

Taro: The same business semantics as uni-app; The System module self-includes pages, apis and Zustand states; H5 SSE, weapp polling; The action is navigated by stabilizing the viewKey. core does not rely on notification services.

client does not permanently accumulate `unread_delta`: SSE/ polling only triggers Summary, avoiding count drift caused by repetition, out-of-order, and multiple devices.

## 11. Capacity and Reservation

Delivery is the capacity-driven item: `rows = sum(message unique recipient count)`. For example, 100 tenants * 1,000 users * 10 all-staff broadcasts per month = 1 million lines per month. If the rows and indexes are approximately 300 to 600 bytes, then it is about 300 to 600MB per month. When implementing, use real MySQL for measurement.

unread first period MySQL check: tenant+user, read_at NULL, archived/deleted/revoked NULL, and filter Message withdrawal/expiration. Redis cache is added only after the indicator proves that it is necessary. cache misses return to source and provide recalculation/drift monitoring.

suggested retention: Regular 180 days; Safety/compliance 365 days or in accordance with regulations; No updated draft for 90 days; FAILED Dispatch for at least 30 days. Clean up in small batches of 1000 to 5000 lines: Delivery -> Dispatch -> Message. In the first phase, no zoning will be done. After tens of millions of rows are cleared and become a bottleneck, an assessment will be made.

## 12. Failure Recovery and monitoring

Fault Convergence Mode
| --- | --- |
: Crashed after COMMIT but before joining the team; Relay scan PENDING
: Redis unavailable! Dispatch reserved database, dodge and retry
: Consumer crashes; PEL reclaim + DB lease expires
: Crash before ack after batch commit! cursor/version + Delivery unique idempotent
: Stream is trimmed. Dispatch to rebuild the Queue task
| SSE no flow/buffer full/break line | onopen/onShow/Page/Summary back to the source |
: Dispatch Retry exhausted/FAILED + desensitization error + manual Retry, no cursor reset

Message created/published/revoked; Delivery inserted; Dispatch pending/running/failed, oldest pending, batch duration, retry; Redis stream length, PEL, oldest idle, claim, XADD/XACK errors; SSE connection, 401/403, TryPublish false, reconnect; Summary/Page delay.

alerts: oldest pending >5 minutes, FAILED new addition, PEL continuous growth, stream length reaches max 80%, sudden increase in claims, sudden increase in cross-tenant rejections, SSE reconnection storm, slow unread queries.

log field: message_id, dispatch_id, tenant_id, audience, cursor, batch_size, attempt, queue_message_id, trace_id, error_class.

## 13. Verification matrix

- Concurrently publish only one Message with the same idempotent key; There is only one Delivery for overlapping audiences.
- Redis is posted when it is down and relays for final delivery after recovery.
- handler error leave PEL; claim after the time limit; If the ack fails after submission, the Delivery will not be repeated.
- Small max length can still be restored by Dispatch after forced cropping.
- Multiple instances competing for the same Dispatch only have valid lease advances.
- Tenant A/ User A queries other tenants/users for delivery and returns RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.
- MarkAllRead watermark does not mark new messages during execution.
- Withdraw immediately from query/unread exclusion, and add revoked_at in the background.
-admin /authuser/user can subscribe to notification, but user cannot subscribe to the operation and maintenance flow. The two SSE entries are consistent.
- Summary converges after disconnection, buffer full, multiple tabs, and multiple device operations.
-Admin Bright/Dark/Gray/Color weak; uni/Taro H5 SSE; Wechat onShow/ Polling/pagination /viewKey.
-1, 100, 10,000, 100,000 audience pressure testing; Summary/Page EXPLAIN of millions of deliveries; The ordinary CRUD and connection pool are stable during broadcasting.

## 14. Implemented in phases

Stage 0: Freeze four tables/states/apis; Confirm the classification strategy, valid users, department subtrees, and retention period; Validate the index and batch with temporary data.

Stage 1: Four tables, Default Classification, migration /GORM Gen, Publisher, USER/TENANT, Outbox Relay, Redis Consumer, User API, Three-end Inbox and mini-program refresh; Accept Redis fault recovery and tenant isolation.

Phase 2: Message and classification management, timing/recall/retry, ROLE/DEPT/POST, expired receipt cleaning, Monitoring, Admin Header; The acceptance of 10,000-person broadcasting and failure can be restored.

Stage 3: Core Principal/ flow-level authorization, notification SSE, Admin/H5 shared connection, reconnection reconciliation; The acceptance user/authuser can receive notifications but cannot access the operation and maintenance flow.

Stage 4: Redis Pub/Sub multi-node wake-up, increase unread cache/ speed limit/partition by metric, and then consider Save, Snooze, preference and external channels.

## 15. Clearly not to do it

- Delivery success is not defined as SSE success, and Redis Stream is not used as the permanent message repository.
- Does not introduce Asynq/Kafka/ the second Queue, and does not degenerate into an unregulated goroutine when the queue fails.
- Do not create a Redis Stream for each user and do not put large user arrays into the Queue.
- Do not return HTTP only after all staff have fan-out completed in synchronization.
- Do not allow the client to determine the tenant/user stream and do not use the query token.
- not mixed the read/archive/revoke/delete, not in situ modification has been released.
- Does not allow notifications to bypass business permissions and does not support arbitrary HTML/ script/component paths.
- Do not build template markets, complex rule engines or multi-channel platforms in advance.

## 16. Product items to be confirmed

1. Disable whether the user receives new messages; It is recommended not to receive it and not to make up for the historical broadcasts after restoration.
Does
2.DEPT contain subdepartments by default? It is recommended to make an explicit selection.
3. Whether the history of expired messages can be checked; It is recommended that the main inbox be hidden and the management audit be retained.
4. Whether the user's personal deletion is restored; It is recommended that the first installment not be restored but only be soft-hidden.
5. Can security messages be deleted by individuals? It is recommended that it not be deleted during the retention period.
6. Whether the 180-day default retention complies with regulations.
7. Is the external link open in the first phase? It is recommended to support only VIEW_KEY.
8. Whether cross-tenant manual broadcasting will be opened in the first phase; It is suggested that it be closed.

final boundary: MySQL Delivery is the fact, Dispatch is the recoverable Outbox/ cursor, Redis Streams is the asynchronous execution carrier, SSE is the online optimization, and the client backsource constitutes the final consistency closed loop.

# Overall system design

This article only describes the modules, running relationships and expansion boundaries that already exist in the current warehouse. For the document entry, see [docs/README](README.md). The specific commands are subject to the README and Makefile of each module.

## module

| Modules | Responsibilities | Products |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backend` | Kratos HTTP/gRPC service, authentication authority, MFA, open authorization client, system business, AI, tasks, migration and static hosting. | Go services, OpenAPI |
| `kratos-core` | Reusable Kratos host runtime without business proto. | Standalone Go module |
| `frontend/admin/packages/core` | Management side startup, login, MFA verification, dynamic routing, layout, status and common components. |`@liujitcn/kratos-admin-core`|
| `frontend/admin/packages/modules/system` | System management, personal center, security settings, AI, open authorization client and development tools page. |`@liujitcn/kratos-admin-system`|
| `frontend/admin/packages/cli` | Create a business management end workspace. |`@liujitcn/kratos-admin-cli`|
| `frontend/admin/apps/admin` | The default management host that combines core and System. | Private package `@liujitcn/kratos-admin`, `backend/data/admin` |
| `frontend/uni-app` | Home, Login, My, Profile, Settings, WebView and AI uni-app application. | `@liujitcn/kratos-uni-app`, `backend/data/uni-app` |
| `frontend/taro-app` | A React/Taro application that shares the backend contract with uni-app, supporting H5 and WeChat applets. | `@liujitcn/kratos-taro-app`, `backend/data/taro-app` |
| `backend/migration` | Versioned database and initialization data. | Embedded SQL |

The warehouse currently does not have business modules such as shopping mall, order, payment, recommendation, etc.

## Running relationship

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Admin["管理端宿主"] -->|"/api /events"| Backend["Backend"]
  UniApp["uni-app"] -->|"/api"| Backend
  Taro["Taro app"] -->|"/api"| Backend
  Backend --> DB[("MySQL")]
  Backend --> Redis[("Redis")]
  Backend -->|"/admin/"| AdminFiles["data/admin"]
  Backend -->|"/uni-app/"| UniAppFiles["data/uni-app"]
  Backend -->|"/taro-app/"| TaroFiles["data/taro-app"]
  Backend -->|"/data/"| UploadFiles["data/<业务类型>/<文件分类>/<年>/<月>/<日>"]
  Module["外部 core.Module"] --> Backend
```

Backend can run independently or connect to other Core hosts through the public `ProviderSet`, `NewModuleResources`, `NewModules`, `NewTasks`, `NewStreams` and `NewQueueConsumers`. The two forms reuse the same Service, biz and Repository; in-process calls use `Runtime.ClientConn()`, and remote calls use standard gRPC connections.

## Backend layering

```text
api/proto
  -> api/gen/go
  -> internal/service/{base/v1,system/admin/v1,system/app/v1}
  -> internal/biz/{base,system/admin,system/app,...}
  -> internal/data/gen
```

- Proto is the only contract source for HTTP, gRPC, checksum frontend types.
- service only does transmission adaptation and error recovery, business rules are placed in biz, and database access is limited to data.
- `internal/server/{base/v1,system/admin/v1,system/app/v1}` registers the transmission service; `internal/module` is responsible for the module adaptation from Admin to Core and the public Wire combination root, `internal/cmd/server` is responsible for the independent process startup entrance, and `bootstrap.go` provides the external host assembly facade through the public ProviderSet.
- Cross-module data access is only possible using generated clients, which do not expose internal Model, Query, Repository or Case.

Core's `Module` is responsible for gRPC, HTTP, and MCP registration; Core also uniformly registers `/data/` local OSS static mapping based on `oss.root_directory`. Optional Contributors provide middleware, backend servers, OpenAPI, tasks, queue consumers, SSE, startup scripts, startup hooks, health checks, and static resources.

## Front-end boundary

The management side dependency direction is fixed to:

```text
apps/admin -> packages/modules/system -> packages/core
```

The business module provides module-prefixed pages, static page replacements, top tools, user menus, routing options, and named extensions via `AdminModule`. The module list for the default host is only maintained at `apps/admin/src/module-manifest.ts`.

The application side is an independent pnpm workspace, and the dependency direction is fixed as:

```text
apps/uni-app -> packages/modules/system -> packages/core
```

`KratosAppModule` declares pages, stable view keys, and static icons via `pages`, `views`, and `icons`. The host only maintains `apps/uni-app/src/module-manifest.ts`, and the Vite plug-in exposed by core scans the module page and merges `pages.json` and static resources during the build period.

Taro application uses independent React/Taro workspace, and the dependency direction is:

```text
apps/taro-app -> packages/modules/* -> packages/ui -> packages/core
```

`defineKratosTaroModule()` declares the runtime module, `defineKratosTaroBuildModule()` provides the build-time page description; `packages/core`'s runner generates page wrappers, subcontracting configurations and static resources during development or build, and the host only submits fixed bootstrap pages.

## Contract and generation

| Command | Output |
| --- | --- |
| `make -C backend api` | `backend/api/gen/go` |
| `make -C backend openapi` | `backend/internal/openapi/assets/openapi.yaml` |
KRATOSTOKEN0002: | `make -C backend openapi` | `backend/internal/openapi/assets/openapi.yaml`, KRATOSTOKEN0002, KRATOSTOKEN0003, KRATOSTOKEN0004 |
| `make i18n-openapi` | `backend/internal/openapi/assets/openapi.yaml`、`openapi.en-US.yaml`、`openapi.zh-TW.yaml`、`openapi.ja-JP.yaml` |
| `make -C frontend ts-admin` | Management side core and System `src/rpc` |
| `make -C frontend ts-uni-app` | `src/rpc` for uni-app core and system packages |
| `make -C frontend ts-taro-app` | `src/rpc` for Taro core and system packages |
| `make -C frontend ts` | Generate management, uni-app and Taro all at once `src/rpc` |
| `make -C backend gorm-gen` | `backend/internal/data/gen` |
| `make -C backend wire` | `backend/internal/cmd/server/wire_gen.go` |

The interface change is completed by "Proto → Generate → service/biz → Front-end request and page → Migrate permissions". The generated files do not need to be modified manually.

## Data and Permissions

Migration resources are fixed and maintained at `backend/migration/assets/v0.0.1/<database-type>/<data-source?>`. MFA, open authorization and its permission initialization are all directly written to `v0.0.1`; new functions also update this initial version, and no higher versions or incremental migrations are added. At startup, GORM automatically creates tables according to configuration, then executes initialization SQL, and finally synchronizes `base_api`, tenant role menu and Casbin policy from OpenAPI and menu relationships.

JWT access/refresh token is used for authentication; password transmission uses one-time RSA-OAEP + AES-GCM hybrid encryption; tenant and permissions are determined by the server.

## Document Index

| Topics | Documentation |
| --- | --- |
| Backend and Core | [backend README](../backend/README.md), standalone `kratos-core` repository |
| Management | [frontend/admin README](../frontend/admin/README.md) |
| Application side | [frontend/uni-app README](../frontend/uni-app/README.md) |
| Taro application | [frontend/taro-app README](../frontend/taro-app/README.md) |
| New capability access | [Service access guide ](服务接入指南.md) |
| Database | [Database and initialization data design ](数据库与初始化数据设计.md) |
| Interface verification | [Interface parameter verification design ](接口参数校验设计.md) |
| Login | [Login and password encryption process ](登录与密码加密流程.md) |
| AI | [AI assistant design ](AI助手设计.md) |
| Site message | [Site message design ](站内信设计.md) |
| Management-side components | [Front-end component list ](前端组件清单.md) |
| International Design | [International Final Solution ](国际化最终方案.md) |
| New languages | [International Language Expansion Guide ](国际化语言扩展指南.md) |
